Many of these universities canceled classes and commencement due to pro-terror protests. Police have arrested students and even professors at several institutions due to violence!

Voter participation has been increasing, and young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights -- see the importance of voting now more than ever. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
Turnout is going to be key , and we're going to make sure we can get every pro-democracy voter to the ballot that we can, armed with the information they need to show up and vote. We're going to make sure every single mail-in ballot is lawfully cast and counted . We’re contacting voters ahead of every key registration, ballot request, and early voting deadline... and those deadlines are coming up fast .
This election will determine whether our democracy goes back to the darkness and conspiracy theories of the recent past or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: The return of Betsy Devos
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2109%2E135344%2EsArUb-)

Friend -
If you were waiting for the perfect time to make your first donation to my campaign for Senate, not only is today the perfect day but there's also a very good reason as well.
Betsy DeVos.
If you're already familiar with her significant support for my opponent and are ready to chip in, please use this link to give:
**[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/beat-devos](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241022-5-900&t=2&akid=2109%2E135344%2EsArUb-)**
Otherwise, let me go a little deeper ... including a very recent revelation about her designs on a role in a second Trump administration.
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and one of his longest serving cabinet secretaries.
Much like our Republican opponent, Mike Rogers, she condemned Donald Trump after January 6, 2021. In Betsy DeVos’ case, she “resigned in protest” as Education Secretary, blaming his rhetoric on the insurrection -- just 13 days before the end of Trump’s term.
And like my current opponent who turned around and worked hard for Trump's endorsement, Betsy DeVos is now back -- and willing to serve in a second Trump administration.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241022-5-900&t=3&akid=2109%2E135344%2EsArUb-)
So what does that mean?
As if there weren't already a million reasons to defeat Donald Trump, there's now one more: keeping Betsy DeVos out of any role of prominence in Washington, D.C.
And there is no doing that without winning in Michigan.
The DeVos family has been some of the top supporters to opponents of mine in the past, and they've doubled down on this Senate race.
Mike Rogers' first FEC report in this race was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family -- contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day. Just a day before our primary election in August, Betsy DeVos herself was campaigning with Mike Rogers at a roundtable.
They are certainly not done with their support of my opponent.
On a positive note, the response to emails about the DeVos donations has raised far more than the DeVos family has contributed. But we have to keep going, because their family's unlimited wealth can impact this race in many more ways.
So in light of this news about Betsy DeVos' potential return to Washington, D.C. and her role in campaigning for my opponent, I am asking:
[**Can you contribute $3 directly to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan? I will put your donation made today in Betsy’s name right to work persuading the voters we need to win in Michigan.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241022-5-900&t=4&akid=2109%2E135344%2EsArUb-)

After graduating, I spent eight years in combat flying Apache helicopters in Iraq. I served as a platoon leader and I took on the same terrorists who wanted to destroy the American Dream my father worked so hard for. | | | Friend, When my dad turned 18, he was turned away from his dream college because he was black. But he didn’t give up. My dad worked his way up in America in a system where everything was rigged against him. And during that time, he watched Americans of all colors rise up with him against the racism of Jim Crow. **My father learned that in America, good will always trump evil. That’s why he taught me that our great country is ALWAYS worth fighting for.** **_That’s why I decided as a young man to attend the U.S. Military Academy at West Point._** After graduating, I spent eight years in combat flying Apache helicopters in Iraq. I served as a platoon leader and I took on the same terrorists who wanted to destroy the American Dream my father worked so hard for. **_Now, I’m furious to see Democrats who want us to go BACKWARDS and make skin color the thing that DIVIDES us once again._** From WOKE Critical Race theory to erasing women’s sports and our nation’s history, they want to destroy everything we’ve worked for and turn Americans against each other based on where they come from and the color of our skin. _That is the_** _COMPLETE OPPOSITE_** _of the America I fought for, and it’s not the kind of country I want to live in._ **I ran for Congress because I believe the American Dream should be available to EVERYONE, regardless of race, color, or creed. ** **As you can probably guess, that’s not going over so well with the Marxists on the socialist Left. ** **Those who traffic in racial politics, and those who know that an America that is DIVIDED is an America that is WEAKER are in full force to end my candidacy once and for all. ** **I need your help to defend it.** **[**Will you join our fight today?**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=45bf2834197d4e88acd6b770df9f940e&_e=dz8yGgCh9STYigK8LGMZPgvYYJI3a7WEaV6ZntllJ2-dZ8XMTHqCYraOZZEIYw4C0zG9bQpSVzz-ZiUiWesoTKFtCnYCOHEeZPCm58dWXoHe0Qe604RGZb8VvPuFUqjmffX9x_UlQy8B24RTuGicpcnXO-1jmK7X2T-_MjKNYit6S4BL03_QAxOtZ3qj2-rAzs6ay7LN-bwGGJdCNEhsf9SwKbSzangH84JcFxvumeFZiPyA6BlwHeWenKs3u48Hsd2KcuHNCDF6NMjZtAO6RESXrQMVfwvZNjw2CHeWY7bn0TpIrrcSnuLwGbBieAmGAfqUuqwrgkKmaPcH655nl77imZyOMpw7wmZmkOUwW6Uu196xUlu9oaQuctzvt3jIvSfknaoiK_4lNshUdmDsOp4MQTq4P9bHtBBxe5Y-ePj_k2mfrZdsMOIAP4Mwphvt)** ****

body:
#
**There are exactly two weeks until Election Day** , when Alexandria will be facing off against her Republican opponent, and Party control of the House, Senate, and White House will be determined.
Whether we’re able to make progress on so many issues of importance will be determined by what happens on November 5th. Reproductive freedom, protecting Social Security, addressing the climate crisis, and so many more issues are at stake.
We cannot allow for right-wing extremists to win the White House, Senate, and the House of Representatives. The future direction of our country and our basic rights hinge on what takes place on November 5th.
These stakes are why Alexandria has been visiting battleground districts and states like Pennsylvania and Wisconsin to Get Out The Vote for leaders in **MUST WIN** races.
Alexandria takes no donations from corporations, lobbyists, or special interests. This campaign is 100% funded by grassroots donations every step of the way.
[ Will you stand with us today and make a $5 contribution to power our fight against Trump's extremism?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241022.vAlwmB&refcode=em20241022-7432-P_FND_EGR_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7432%2E2526796%2Ea7aAr8) Without a concerted effort to combat the MAGA movement, right-wing extremists will endanger our democracy itself.
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241022.vAlwmB&refcode=em20241022-7432-P_FND_EGR_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=7432%2E2526796%2Ea7aAr8)**
On behalf of Alexandria and our entire team: whether or not you can give today, thank you for standing with us.

body:
Dear Peter,

My jaw hit the floor when I heard the news . . .

California Attorney General Rob Bonta just announced he’s suing Providence St. Joseph Hospital – a Catholic hospital.

Why?

The hospital refused to commit an abortion on a mother carrying twins!

Yes, pro-abortion radicals are fighting to FORCE legal abortion – up until birth – on every state in the country.

But don’t think for one second that they’ll stop there.

They want to FORCE you and me to pay for it, and then they want to FORCE you and me to commit the killings too.

So, will you help me EXPOSE Kamala Harris’ anti-Christian, pro-abortion extremism by making a generous contribution to Students for Life Action
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/6K_ym-b30r3vrP7l_FHm6Q~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo-s_
?

Peter, putting a target on Christians’ backs isn’t new to Kamala Harris . . .

In fact, she’s shown an extreme bias against pro-life Christians and Catholics throughout her entire career, including:

• As Attorney General of California, she used lawfare to go after pro-life Christians, even raiding the house of Center for Medical Progress founder Daniel Daleiden after he obtained undercover videos of Planned Parenthood staffers bragging about selling aborted-baby body parts. She charged him with 15 felonies while the Abortion Goliath got off scot-free.

She also championed California’s Reproductive FACE Act, which FORCED Pregnancy Resource Centers to provide information on where to get abortions and was one of 14 state attorneys general to file an amicus brief with the Supreme Court, demanding they FORCE Hobby Lobby to cover Chemical Abortion Pills.

• As a U.S. Senator, she scrutinized judicial nominees for their Knights of Columbus memberships and implied the Catholic organization was an “extremist” group.

She also twice voted against the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Act – which would have protected babies who survive botched abortions – and supported legislation that would have ended religious exemptions for certain government mandates.

• As Vice President, she demonized Pregnancy Resource Centers and became the first Vice President in U.S. history to visit and speak at a Planned Parenthood abortion facility.

Now she’s trying to finish her reign as VP by pandering to the very Christians she’s endlessly attacked, saying: “One does not need to abandon their faith” to support her radical late-term, abortion-on-demand agenda...all while telling two college pro-life boys that they needed to go to the other rally after shouting “Jesus is Lord” in the middle of her rally.

Peter, everything I’ve just told you is exactly what we’ll get more of if Kamala Harris is elected on November 5th.

And not just more of it . . . but worse.

Worse abortion laws than Roe v. Wade ever was, worse anti-Christian and anti-Catholic discrimination, and worse attacks on our rights to Life, religion, and speech.

The lawsuit against Providence St. Joseph Hospital in California is just the tip of the spear . . .

If elected, pro-abortion radicals across the country will be empowered by Kamala’s reign to intimidate, threaten, vandalize, and even commit violence against pro-life Christians.

You and I MUST do everything in our power to stop this from happening.

Will you please act by making your most generous contribution to Students for Life Action so I can fight Kamala Harris through our critical Election Year Programs
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/t31UEK6nJjGEh4so-s2AZA~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo-s_
?

If we hope to abolish abortion in America, we have to first defeat Kamala Harris!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

Friend, I need to come clean —
I talk a lot about how important it is to reach my fundraising goals, [**_like my $500,000 goal before midnight tonight._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95604736/507303354/-2090042367?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2346-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTE0ODk0MjItZGE5MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-hU1uHQp7oQS16YI-2RhBgASDABAva9_zpVxTOItGtA=)** ** But it's not just to keep my ads on the air or the lights on at HQ. **Our ability to hit these goals are a vital measure of our strength to win on Election Day — and my unspeakably wealthy opponent, Rick Scott,_is_ watching us.**
But despite Rick Scott personally floating himself a cool **$14 MILLION** so far, he's not the only big spender seeking to drown me out of Florida's race.
Truth is, Rick's super PAC is also bankrolling his reelection bid, with _truly massive_ donations from corporate giants **— most notably, Big Sugar.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95604737/507303355/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2346-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTE0ODk0MjItZGE5MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-hU1uHQp7oQS16YI-2RhBgASDABAva9_zpVxTOItGtA=)
A major power player — _and polluter _— in Florida,** Big Sugar groups like U.S. Sugar and Florida Crystals have given Rick's PAC $775,000 this cycle to target me with attack ads, and keep my voice from reaching voters.**
_But_ _how do you think Scott earned such a sweet deal?_
While governor, he hit state water management boards — which worked to restore the Everglades — with a **$700 MILLION budget cut **— driving a spike in pollution entering Florida's fragile wetland ecosystems.
Then, he **REPEALED** a law requiring regular septic tank inspections. When they leaked, the sewage entered our waters, only worsening the issue.
Finally, he **ABOLISHED** the Department of Community Affairs, which protected Florida communities from dangerous, greed-driven corporate activities.
**And Big Sugar —** whose crop-burning methods pollute the air near Black and Hispanic communities, and whose fertilizer-laden runoff drove one of the biggest red tide events in recent Florida history**— was a big winner.**
While I fought in Congress to secure $200 million in federal funds to restore the Everglades,** Rick Scott's rollbacks lost over $1 BILLION in revenue between 2017 and 2019, killed thousands of manatees, and left our shores stinking from the smell of countless rotting sea creatures. **
**In short, Rick Scott is 100% BOUGHT by Big Sugar — **and it should leave a bitter taste in the mouth of anyone who cares about the iconic natural beauty or the people that make our Sunshine State so special. _**Ya no más.**_
The only special interests I'm beholden to are those of working Florida families and grassroots donors like you, who power my campaign for progress.
**But up against the double whammy of a filthy-rich Republican and his even bigger industrial allies, I don't stand a chance of overcoming their cash without your support in this final stretch.**

**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

It's hard to describe how humbling it is to hear people say they want ME to be their representative in the House. Sure, I've been making the case on why I think I'm right for the job for over a year.

**But now are the moments when what was an idea... a hope... starts transforming into something real.**

It's not just people telling me at town halls, at their doors, or on the phone that I can count on their vote. It's the real act of filling out that little bubble next to my name and returning that ballot to officially be counted.

[_**It's all led up to this. We have just 14 days left to make the case that I'm the best champion for the families of WI-08. I never planned to run for office. I come from dairy farmers and paper mill workers — not a political dynasty.

I was a young mom when I entered medical school at the University of Wisconsin. By the time I graduated with my M.D. and a masters in public health, I had 4 kids under the age of 10.

I simply wanted to be the best doctor for my patients and the best mom to my sons. And that's what I did, without much fuss, for nearly years.

But when politicians started butting into my exam room, demanding I provide less than care I was trained to give, I couldn't remain quiet.

**So that's why I threw my hat into the ring — because just like I've fought for my patients, I'm ready to fight for the families of WI-08.**

It's an honor that any of my fellow citizens trust me to deliver for them.

clean_body: It's an honor that any of my fellow citizens trust me to deliver for them. | | Team, "I voted for you today!" That's the message I've personally received dozens of times today, as early voting in Wisconsin began. It's hard to describe how humbling it is to hear people say they want ME to be their representative in the House. Sure, I've been making the case on why I think I'm right for the job for over a year. But now are the moments when what was an idea... a hope... starts transforming into something real. It's not just people telling me at town halls, at their doors, or on the phone that I can count on their vote. It's the real act of filling out that little bubble next to my name and returning that ballot to officially be counted. = I never planned to run for office. I come from dairy farmers and paper mill workers — not a political dynasty. I was a young mom when I entered medical school at the University of Wisconsin. By the time I graduated with my M.D. and a masters in public health, I had 4 kids under the age of 10. I simply wanted to be the best doctor for my patients and the best mom to my sons. And that's what I did, without much fuss, for nearly years. But when politicians started butting into my exam room, demanding I provide less than care I was trained to give, I couldn't remain quiet. So that's why I threw my hat into the ring — because just like I've fought for my patients, I'm ready to fight for the families of WI-08. name: OKGOP
subject: Here’s what you need to know about the Oklahoma judges on your ballot!
body:
| [ ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaIOiUFGhm1XQHaiZ59fvCoY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_here_s_what_you_need_to_know&n=1)
---
Peter -- Did you know you will have numerous judges on your Oklahoma ballot? These positions are hugely important, yet they are often entirely overlooked. We want you to be highly informed when you cast your ballot, so we at the OKGOP have created a two page document about all 12 judges for you to print, post, share, & distribute any way you choose. The most important thing we can tell you is we **ABSOLUTELY** recommend you **VOTE NO** on **ALL THREE Oklahoma Supreme Court Judges**. The question will be should they be retained in their position yes or no. We believe they should NOT be retained, so if you agree they must go you should **VOTE NO**. Fairly easy to remember: the Supreme Court judges must go, so **VOTE NO!** Their names are Noma D. Gurich, James E. Edmondson, & Yvonne Kauger. They are all three extremely liberal & very much out of alignment with Oklahoma values & Republican principles. They’ve consistently legislated from the bench to overturn conservative Republican legislation that the majority of Oklahomans support. Simply put, they are trying to enforce their liberal “values” on the rest of Oklahoma through their court decisions. They **MUST GO** , so we must **VOTE NO!**
## **One more time: VOTE NO on all three Oklahoma Supreme Court Judges. Their names are Gurich, Edmondson, Kauger.**
In addition to those 3 judges on the Supreme Court, we have 3 Criminal Appeals Court Judges to vote on & 6 Civil Appeals Court Judges. Below you will find information we’re providing on each of those judges that can help you in determining how you will vote. Information like if they are registered Republican or something else, their age, how long they’ve been a judge overall & in their current role, & which Governor put them in their position. There are numerous other groups that have provided voting recommendations on all these remaining judges, so you can find those online. We wanted you to have additional information in order to make an informed decision based on your preferences. For instance many have said they will vote yes to keep the judges appointed by Governor Stitt since he’s been such a strong Republican Governor. Others are looking at how long someone has been in their position. **Did you know Judge Kauger has been on the Oklahoma Supreme Court LONGER than Nancy Pelosi has been in Congress?** And looking at their ideology one could see they are very similar in many ways not just length of time in office. However you decide to vote, we wanted you to have information to help you in making that decision. Click here [JUDGES](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=famEQU5nnF1S-b88XDM1tLxD6ai9XC75IRPs8gdaYV6eoenpIIQ0iZ6yt-CYlUsY7v-iaE-awQ_VjsNNKpwxz1gfwl_dEm0S8083PGUgoDwjz54uBtKr7_6ZmWnUeSnj&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_here_s_what_you_need_to_know&n=2) to download the pdf of all 12 judges that you can then save, print, or share as you choose. Or visit [OKGOP.com/judges ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaGgblsdN-B0X9YNkesVHGfc&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_here_s_what_you_need_to_know&n=3) OKGOP Team P.S. Did you notice we mentioned to **VOTE NO** on all three Oklahoma Supreme Court Judges? **Judges Gurich, Edmondson, & Kauger MUST GO, so we must VOTE NO! Spread the word!** Here is the link one more time: [OKGOP.com/judges](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaGgblsdN-B0X9YNkesVHGfc&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_here_s_what_you_need_to_know&n=4)

This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com). To stop receiving emails, [click here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/unsubscribe?e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_here_s_what_you_need_to_know&n=5).
You can also keep up with OKGOP on [Twitter](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=JcrYNQ7dhdufXPgOgJxNGHSsRONv6mnq7ly6aBOUvGVprSj7jfHNOpP70kR_1QLA&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_here_s_what_you_need_to_know&n=6) or [Facebook](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=UQNagEd-DqbIXa37T8ODid9mG9NGbq3z9te4_riKc6EaGmrOrRzKc2wAaVTFbzRY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_here_s_what_you_need_to_know&n=7).

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: My opponent is spreading dangerous and xenophobic rhetoric
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends,
At this exact moment two weeks ago, I was sitting on stage with my opponent, Bill Wells, for a candidate forum. The goal of this forum was for each of us to share our views and priorities with San Diego voters.
And let me tell you, it was beyond disturbing to hear him use the 90 minutes of that forum to repeatedly demonize immigrants with far-right xenophobic rhetoric.
At one point he even seemed to say that he only wants white immigrants in this country. (Seriously.)
Let’s be clear: This kind of xenophobic rhetoric doesn’t make any of us safer. It’s harmful and divisive, and it’s not going to solve any of the important issues we need to address in San Diego or across the country.
So many of the people stoking fear around immigrants and asylum seekers seem to forget that our current asylum laws were created in the aftermath of the Holocaust, when Jews were denied the refuge they desperately needed.
The values of compassion and justice are the foundation of who we are as a country. People who want to be leaders in our federal government should NOT be demonizing those who are fleeing violence and persecution and seeking safety in America.
Look, through my first two terms in Congress, I’ve heard directly from Customs and Border Protection and those directly working on the issue every day. I visit the border at least once a quarter, and every person I’ve talked to has made it 100% clear that the best way to address our immigration challenges is to create more and faster legal pathways to citizenship.
I’m proud to fight for a compassionate and fact-based approach to immigration in Congress, and I’m asking for your support to keep doing this critical work.
Will you make a contribution to my re-election campaign today to stand against the dangerous rhetoric my opponent is spreading and make sure we defeat him in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you for standing with me on this.
-Sara

Well, thanks to grassroots supporters like you, we're finally rising above the noise: Take a look at my first statewide ad of the general election. = But Florida's ad market is one of the most expensive in the nation — so our next challenge is keeping it on the air. = | | = As someone who came to the United States from a country that suffered under a military dictatorship, for me, the fight for freedom is personal. For too long, extremist Republicans like Scott have co-opted the protection of personal liberties as a top priority — but if we're honest with ourselves, the only "freedoms" he's fighting for in Congress are his own, trying to: Control women's private medical decisions Prevent seniors from retiring with dignity Get even richer off the taxpayers' dime Buy his way into elected office and out of ever facing accountability Scott's understanding of "freedom" begins and ends with himself and his ability to do, say, and spend anything to convince voters otherwise. But because of grassroots supporters like you, we're finally busting his monopoly on the airwaves and letting voters know that they deserve better. As Florida's next Senator, you can count on me to fight for everyone's freedom to live as they choose — and not as extremists like Scott demand. But without your help to hit my rapid-response $500,000 goal by 11:59 p.m., I simply won't be able to keep this message on the air, let alone overcome the volley of televised attacks that he's sure to send our way. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue. | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you, Debbie P.S. In case you haven't seen it yet, to watch my first ad of the general election for yourself. | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

**I 'm the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

**Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice BROKE THE LAW and ILLEGALLY SPIED ON LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS ... and I can PROVE it in court! That means their criminal convictions can be THROWN OUT. And their criminal trials can be THROWN OUT.**

And I'm taking other hard-hitting legal actions to protect our fellow Americans and our endangered rights and freedoms.

Let me tell you, no other legal group in the country is doing what Freedom Watch is doing to defend and free January 6 patriots.

You see, many defense lawyers are scared spitless of the FBI and DOJ. So they tell their clients to plead guilty to crimes they didn't commit ... and they end up in prison.

But Freedom Watch fights!

Patriot, please say a pray for the January 6 prisoners. Their temptation to give up must be enormous.

I can't do it without you.

Thank you for doing whatever you can **now**.

In Justice,

Larry Klayman
Founder, Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Chairman and General Counsel, Freedom Watch, Inc.

| | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z616vvc41s9rmls81g6jt7gtuqiegljvnopvj2d8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sdge8oj6c5h2bs) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." Christi Jacobsen, has irresponsibly used and abused her position as Secretary of State to try to prevent a ballot measure that could legalize abortion from going to a vote. And when that failed, she attempted to purge voters from our rolls to further manipulate the odds of the ballot measure passing. It is just another clear example of how she’s willing to use her office to interfere with the will of the people. The role of Secretary of State should be one of impartiality, ensuring that elections are free, fair, and accessible to all. Instead, Jacobsen is undermining these principles and eroding public trust by injecting her personal politics into the administration of our elections. I am running for Montana Secretary of State to restore faith in our electoral process. I will ensure our elections are administered fairly and protect every Montanan's right to vote. name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Intel
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWSTOOfWNa
A movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many
well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWSTOOfWNa

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

I am
enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will
only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future.

A
movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many
well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president.
In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as
devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's
why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on
Presidential Selection.

By
completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as
possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand
the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue-views we
will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can
complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using
the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63652673:WSTOOfWNa:m:3:2627245898:2B665E3661F6F6815C108B36A14B708B:r

Do you
think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College
works and its role in preserving free and representative
government?
YES
NO

For most
of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the
Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it
was considered essential to preserving free and representative
government.

But
today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an
attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This
movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because
of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with
a proper grounding in American civics-too many Americans simply
don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including
the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because
of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission
on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of
Americans in all 50 states.

These
efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of
our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online
courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide
with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets
popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding
documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and
guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of
charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including
American civics) to thousands of American educators and
homeschoolers.

Your
answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will
help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate
millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to
liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this
is especially important in this critical time for America's
future.

So please
share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National
Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon
as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can
take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63652673:WSTOOfWNa:m:3:2627245898:2B665E3661F6F6815C108B36A14B708B:r

And after
you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting
Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since
1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty."
Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach
efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government
funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state
student grants or loans.

The
support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please
represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential
Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention-and for
your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include: Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;" Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty; Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people; Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers. Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. So, if you can give at this time, don't wait. In service, Tom Cotton ************************************************************************************************** **** | Paid for by the NRSC. So, Vice President Harris is counting on people who understand the stakes of this race to step up today. Yes, today. I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

| | Dear Fellow American,

Is it possible to repair the CIA?

**[To answer this question, Hillsdale College has created a FREE online video series on the history and current crisis in U.S. intelligence](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=27f680e740b9413ea59b23def4d1d961&_e=YAYRxy4ROL_gC-CvOZqWRI8lK-71w1OECRfQjmErIxQWOES1_8PCHSInfEBX9f8S_TkSVnP5b3Xr8tKi3LK38nqIV8fLpRCh_ghS2r_FZIm8T4CTXGMIfjYCeEhf40RYa0g_JUDBvwhI86OTBWvrtg7Gk81au4Agxm364JpV_43CzlOOfKwqBQ1JosWd2E8MDeLgN4MnEgXJ8b3NRXdR13x2Dl5rDQwIfqFXn1-qnSaWAgxBrjqh2TiPTM1Uwvo9KsjNgaWmd61xt0vU79WT8DgEjg5WsLcJK9ZwqoaWwcfB6tX9SI6UegzI7UmHiO_PWM1bTlfL54LlEpLSgikHnIBUvg89_eyR3XyGo3An5MkehAO59xmp9dXYWSrLXWYO-7S6yRBBJri4knmFj_a51w%3D%3D).**

In this online video series, filmed during a conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn why we need intelligence and how it is used against American citizens and duly elected leaders.

The CIA--originally founded as the OSS--was created in the aftermath of Pearl Harbor to help protect America from foreign threats. But in the last few decades, this notorious agency...
* FAILED to foresee the 9/11 attack and then took over a decade to find Osama Bin Ladin

* COVERED for the Obama administration after the assault on our embassy in Benghazi that led to four American deaths

* THREATENED the sovereignty of the American people with the Russia collusion hoax

* FAILED to warn Americans about COVID-19

* HID the origins of the Hunter Biden laptop and declared it Russian disinformation

America's Founders would not recognize this notorious intelligence agency.

We still need intelligence to help protect us from foreign threats. We needed it in the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, and we need it even more today.

But now, the CIA serves its own interests...not those of the American people.

And so, it's no surprise that anyone in power who goes after the CIA is soon _not_ in power.

You might remember when New York Senator Chuck Schumer told MSNBC, **" Let me tell you, you take on the intelligence community, they have six ways from Sunday at getting back at you."**

Whether or not Schumer meant to make such a revealing statement, it is further evidence that you and I live in a country in which powerful government agencies do not operate according to the consent of the governed.

How did we get to this point? And how can we reform the CIA and our other intelligence agencies?

**I invite you to learn more about this critical topic through our free video series, U.S. Intelligence: History and Controversies.**

**You can receive instant access to this series right now using this secure link:**

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/us-intelligence-cca](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=27f680e740b9413ea59b23def4d1d961&_e=YAYRxy4ROL_gC-CvOZqWRI8lK-71w1OECRfQjmErIxQWOES1_8PCHSInfEBX9f8S_TkSVnP5b3Xr8tKi3LK38nqIV8fLpRCh_ghS2r_FZIm8T4CTXGMIfjYCeEhf40RYa0g_JUDBvwhI86OTBWvrtg7Gk81au4Agxm364JpV_43CzlOOfKwqBQ1JosWd2E8MDeLgN4MnEgXJ8b3NRXdR13x2Dl5rDQwIfqFXn1-qnSZCz2lpReu3BcFO9TQA5il8wtzcdbjk-U_XAC8lFNqNOCmLhy_QaqIR9AuZl1pFVtjEoKDaMvgUJ30Zpk9bvyFQJ5HEObvOpJbIhL7c2p1P4SrmzSyT6TuHM8ItD28_q06bIHYS7Bhe-Pw8UjFJxcctl8iiOHIs80Jfs_dK3XHopw%3D%3D)

Learning about the history of U.S. intelligence is essential to understanding our current crisis. I urge you to watch your free online video series on U.S. intelligence today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

## IRS Unveils 2025 Tax Bracket and Deduction Increases
The IRS has announced inflation-related adjustments to [tax provisions for 2025](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuwyAQxvGnwRvWcWDjDAzt4C1dOnS0iDnbVzkQAUnqt6_SvfNP-vTp_3Wezp53juuHv5KrS5oQ0EgFEvUUPO_HZJrgFiIk3ZBTFk-9HQD6ZnO6W5Q6zV5Zg2Z5kTWGehrCBTqCU8PutaYAtQLodd8O0KuFLBpltSW9CAMUuKbcfieOdaNlP9KDcjuna7O7rdZbEfpN4Chw9Jc50rO0a3qxwPH9XjhSKQLHJ2f6rCkfAsfqf27-oFzkxutGWZbqY_A5yEDhPldOsUgE7CTnIn2M6R5nKlKpDrDrBmiyC7cn7zuX3goD69Xz_nep_pfo4fA3AAD__5LbaBs), giving taxpayers higher standard deductions and updated income tax brackets. Single filers will see a [standard deduction](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71uxCAQBOCnwR3WsmDgCoo07i5tSmsP8HkT_CMbnXVvHzl9upFG-kbzdR_uxIWX5yfNOdRxHRDQSAUS9ZCIy3swTQpjzph1k4NyeLPOA9hmCuQ78s4CoUEi36UYnbt1CTttPKJvOFyaAtQKwGrberBqzA6NctplPQoDOXFd9_Z75aVOeSzv9ZX3Nq5zU8JU63YI_SGwF9if59nG5RGvUmB_0QJ7BVdGgT3vh0TATkbauFKRT-LlkI-d4k-uRzvVuTR7SNvJpfBhnTDwnInL31r97_0r4G8AAAD__91eWI4) of $15,000, up $400 from 2024, while married couples filing jointly will get a $30,000 deduction, an $800 increase. [Income thresholds](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO4yAUAL8Gd0TwIGAXFNe4y7VXWsQ8wrvFJgISJ3-_yvZbjzQjzb_LcvGUab_99Ru6HssCAjSXgoNagqf8XvQQXEQEVAM6aWEydhTCDMlJXPW0whT1WWkjbVjHKCZlJoN2vE44kPvYpAAlhTDKnEZhZEQLWlplUUWmBQbqpZ7-F9p7wpjf5Yn1tJZtyC71fm9M_WEwM5h7wkQ5fxiDOZUNdzwag3nHV-u-LhsG8stBFRnMetLGSMOpNv7Yn0i5cRBw5rSvZUPe_Ytfq1-_sDd-JKzIQ-Hv8uDR58xgHqoL94NypmYs0-K2efqJD_23UU8H3wEAAP__HIVqUw) for all tax brackets have also been adjusted, but the top rate of 37% remains unchanged for high earners. These changes, aimed at easing the burden of inflation, won’t take effect until the 2025 tax year, so they’ll impact tax returns filed in 2026.

## List: America's Safest Cities
A new report on [America’s safest cities ranked](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kb-O2zAMxp9G3hxIpPwng4cCgbfrUrQdDVmiY_YkK5DkHPL2RZyst_D7kR9AEuTfj-nDsOft-tMEGsoSJ5CgayVrwMkZ9o9JV25YiICwokF1cG67Xsq2WofF6l4522t5xrmxDns0ZBwuqp9VY88VD89uSgIqKVtsT71s1UIdaNVhR7gILclxien0L_JWVlr8I94pnWwMlR_WUm5Z4A8Bo4Dxy3hPZd3npytgJLcLGLNZKJfacmHKNW-1CZTYGgGjVmdoBY72c8r7nG3imdLETuAFGqk1Ng12Atq9hCnHPVkSeLFxu1Mqn1zeTiDHexB4oWDYv4vWhJvh6ybw8odSiFsR0IDkfMgaAx1Q4kvWV_ra9cDfvw6xXB4H1EdUDfZaIVRpcLcv9p5z2wktr8_Rx1HKd0-6D_A_AAD__3R4jiY) towns in Vermont, Wyoming, Idaho, and Rhode Island among the top five least dangerous locations in the country. The study compared over 180 cities across 41 key safety indicators, including traffic fatalities, assaults per capita, unemployment rates, and the percentage of the uninsured population. The study compared over 180 cities across 41 key safety indicators, including traffic fatalities, assaults per capita, unemployment rates, and the percentage of the uninsured population. | MassGOP Mourns the Passing of State Representative Susan Williams Gifford, Honoring Her Legacy of Leadership and Service
---
---
| Boston, MA- The MassGOP is grieved by the passing of State Representative Susan Williams Gifford, who faithfully served the residents of the 2nd Plymouth District since her election in November 2002. Susan was a tireless advocate for the people of Massachusetts, holding the position of Minority Whip in the House of Representatives. Her leadership extended to key roles, including Ranking Minority Member of the House Committee on Steering, Policy, and Schedule, Ranking Minority Member of the Joint Committee on Agriculture, and as a member of the House Committee on Human Resources and Employee Engagement.
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale expressed her heartfelt condolences on the passing of State Representative Williams Gifford stating, "Susan inspired conservative women across Massachusetts to engage in politics. Her leadership was defined by unwavering commitment to her values, coupled with a unique kindness that touched everyone she encountered. Susan's unyielding commitment to the residents of Carver, Middleboro, and Wareham was truly inspirational and serves as a high standard for all civil servants. This is an immeasurable loss for all of us. On behalf of the party, our thoughts and prayers are with her husband, Mark, and her family as they grieve this profound loss."
###

# [Military leaders need to stop being silent, and sound the alarm about Trump NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfb884efa-b987-4bdb-b13f-a3ca883c4d8d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Former Trump chief of staff and retired general John Kelly has finally gone [on the record](https://default.salsalabs.org/T486aa460-f720-4e57-815e-cf1701594ae3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) to warn of the danger of Trump, and how he would rule like a dictator in a second term. This is good, since military leaders like Kelly have gravitas and credibility that really can influence many voters. **But we need a hell of a lot more of them to speak out NOW. Not off the record. Not subtly and cryptically.[But openly, loudly, and to as many voters as humanly possible](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4b9c4a36-38d0-4729-b233-78ee8d05038f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9).** Historically, these leaders have mostly tried to avoid appearing partisan. But these are not normal times. The republic is threatened, and an actual fascist is counting the days until he can take power -- by force if necessary. These military leaders have taken an oath to defend out nation, and the best way they can do that is to speak out NOW, and do whatever they can to ensure that Trump is defeated in November. [**Add your name, and tell military leaders to stop being silent, and to sound the alarm about Trump NOW.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2ff01a1d-5dc1-45ba-b33f-0874f1cfe8d7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Is it possible to repair the CIA?

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=29fb1e78b6c74b4ab535513280dbe56a&_e=xE12PN7h9n-YIMHEe_2CQgnV6VUG5Wq-tkbwAhaJMoe22X9Q9pmXp3xW03imISZeWrb7PUNXBJmDNn_Ral6H1jfGB5UytyWy7kmSTEZ9xhIaPHQ_LQsLgXZIxJj1CSzPU3Som7lP8kK1Pny8nnRvOvFWxgKvVxF2JqfaQwLNbkiRQfgZM5RqREt95ibDRpnugde9D0PEcprkef6Nx-z5m-06lpBBmgaHZhRKzgtgWdptVOpLFIPje01I_NemPQb6fH-_9FfQQBv4Ew6PD7VRUVIw7FiAV-axqCRIZPEBXrQpN_pox-HxyK4vAyhiFmnjjHJAz4Rf5nDVwpQ3cuDlh4M5CCz01B_gMmMGsS3qBlmmRMyQu7qxzitN06cNQC4PNPllvEbYCcRMpS02vq5bIw%3D%3D)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

Is it possible to repair the CIA?

**[To answer this question, Hillsdale College has created a FREE online video series on the history and current crisis in U.S. intelligence](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=29fb1e78b6c74b4ab535513280dbe56a&_e=xE12PN7h9n-YIMHEe_2CQgnV6VUG5Wq-tkbwAhaJMoe22X9Q9pmXp3xW03imISZeWrb7PUNXBJmDNn_Ral6H1jfGB5UytyWy7kmSTEZ9xhIaPHQ_LQsLgXZIxJj1CSzPU3Som7lP8kK1Pny8nnRvOvFWxgKvVxF2JqfaQwLNbkiRQfgZM5RqREt95ibDRpnugde9D0PEcprkef6Nx-z5m-06lpBBmgaHZhRKzgtgWdpMLssC6o3umI61kDsez2MHXxPaRevrxt8APjZFNT-6ZUpTqDHmqFIXCHLuJoT8BtVsmJlZpDYTiYadgJ1Kc7nNxSNi-MwHzGq-dHuEweUCwcjPPiNBJvmT0ZBhsyE0U5WTlSCDktwtOCn5CokuOtNdNXicRgpONSzvKRkR1p4YOg%3D%3D).**

In this online video series, filmed during a conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn why we need intelligence and how it is used against American citizens and duly elected leaders.

The CIA--originally founded as the OSS--was created in the aftermath of Pearl Harbor to help protect America from foreign threats. But in the last few decades, this notorious agency...
* FAILED to foresee the 9/11 attack and then took over a decade to find Osama Bin Ladin

* COVERED for the Obama administration after the assault on our embassy in Benghazi that led to four American deaths

* THREATENED the sovereignty of the American people with the Russia collusion hoax

* FAILED to warn Americans about COVID-19

* HID the origins of the Hunter Biden laptop and declared it Russian disinformation

America's Founders would not recognize this notorious intelligence agency.

We still need intelligence to help protect us from foreign threats. We needed it in the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, and we need it even more today.

But now, the CIA serves its own interests...not those of the American people.

And so, it's no surprise that anyone in power who goes after the CIA is soon _not_ in power.

You might remember when New York Senator Chuck Schumer told MSNBC, **" Let me tell you, you take on the intelligence community, they have six ways from Sunday at getting back at you."**

Whether or not Schumer meant to make such a revealing statement, it is further evidence that you and I live in a country in which powerful government agencies do not operate according to the consent of the governed.

How did we get to this point? And how can we reform the CIA and our other intelligence agencies?

**I invite you to learn more about this critical topic through our free video series, U.S. Intelligence: History and Controversies.**

**You can receive instant access to this series right now using this secure link:**

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/us-intelligence-cca](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=29fb1e78b6c74b4ab535513280dbe56a&_e=xE12PN7h9n-YIMHEe_2CQgnV6VUG5Wq-tkbwAhaJMoe22X9Q9pmXp3xW03imISZeWrb7PUNXBJmDNn_Ral6H1jfGB5UytyWy7kmSTEZ9xhIaPHQ_LQsLgXZIxJj1CSzPU3Som7lP8kK1Pny8nnRvOvFWxgKvVxF2JqfaQwLNbkiRQfgZM5RqREt95ibDRpnugde9D0PEcprkef6Nx-z5m-06lpBBmgaHZhRKzgtgWdoxwYGSPIo79jKj9LKJtoWx3DDB4tOLPlLnTINIk6xR4qKv35ztAV-6uOcKtsaIBkc6aixAq7WZmxIENKnAGJo9CB7yaw593EzVkt6VhAOzdrQcR4WWrCEcgagdjdA3H4_lf3kHsKgMahNt8ryQQRWV5IdrwwPclqGbBnkY_nHOCw%3D%3D)

Learning about the history of U.S. intelligence is essential to understanding our current crisis. I urge you to watch your free online video series on U.S. intelligence today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**Good morning!** On this day in 1904, legendary golf coach and author [Harvey Penick](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z72OrSAUQOGngU4DGxQpKG5jd247pUHYCBk8GCX-vP1kTj_9ypesr9f0simn9_LfrmjqHcoEDGTDWQNi8jblZ5LUm5l5zSkarkD3SncD0GhU6Bz2MminGbfcuRmZDCoMbMAO-ECT-cU4A8GZgE60HoDLQTOlLIdZzEQy9KmWva0RK972CPkpJ-6tKyvNJta6HUT8IzASGK_raj_RUnKIJbRlXwiMeMc0p0pgjHY_8Wk2fCf3TXfjtyvlnI5eEcmW1ab8ceufo6eBnwAAAP__0pdWAA) was born in Austin. Penick coached the University of Texas golf team from 1931 to 1963. He's the author of the best-selling _Harvey Penick's Little Red Book_ on principles and strategies of the game. ## Love Field Fire Burns Warehouses
A large fire near Dallas Love Field [damaged six commercial buildings](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGPhCAUBOBfgx0GHihrQXGN3V57pXnAU0lQN8Iuu__-4vVXT-bLZH7u0x1jivvyjRvZ8p6PCQRoLgUHNQWM6TPpJlgnwiAbstLA0Juhu0GzWqXC0PlOeUQnJXlPstfK9Z3UKB2JJtoLkwKUFAo61QYAqW-DMAYlOOWYFhRiOc62rFTojXlOn-NFZ-uPrUl2LeWRmfpiMDIYa63t7nyY6xUzGHeqmcGYDo-JwXgV97ishQdMCTOveNJ6PDPxOZ7EA264UOaZXnRi4u4ZU4j7chmqN0bojsHYnDY8akwp5t4wLZYNY_rbU_496GXhNwAA___l42iq) Monday night. Stacks of wooden pallets [provided tinder for the three-alarm fire](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j72urCAQx58GOg0MCGtBcRu7ve0pzQijkoyrUbLuvv2J9qf9f-b38-yfmDm_pv-4UCifce1Bga20qsD0CTN_eytTGFRqtaSgPbTOt80D5BysH6LxOjqNTVKWEia0zqiHa6JxGGUO15hWYLQy0Jg6AWj7aJX3qGEwg7CKUi7rXpeZCn3wGPm7vmmv47pIDnMp2yHMPwGdgO48zzoOx4vO4_IFdHdFQHdJAjrGfaJqQ2Yq1Zh3qhIy3wm5h7SdmTkfzgurpgUz3y_lT-x3gN8AAAD__1tBWe0). About 70 firefighters battled the warehouse blaze for nearly 12 hours. No injuries were reported, but electricity was cut to 1,400 residents as a precautionary measure. ([Watch Video](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DFvwyAUBOBfgzcseOAAA0MXb-na0XrmQYJEQmSTkPz7Klk6dTyd9Ol0P8fliLnk6-kbL9G3Z6oLCNBcCg5qIczlteiB_CrIySF6acAdjJssDGe_BgsHnJIwSAHVmrRaXbIQlVPOWRiyf2NSgJJCwaRGApDaOmEMSljVyrSIlFvdxnaOLT5xT-VVH3EbQ70MxZ9bu-1MfTGYGcy997EnxHfJYMat5VAig_ka-85gLjVgYTATloI7D_V-ba-__PF5qY_IU46FeMpb5Lfa48brveHpTYE1PGoMjqzjZIPjelLEHSFxmhSs0kgBFofN063nUvJ-MEyL0wVz-axu_9748PAbAAD__69ncv0))
## Formula 1 Fines Track for Security Breach
Formula 1 [fined the Circuit of the Americas ](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2u4yAQRp8Gd2PB4N-CYht3d9strTGMYxSMIyCx8_arpL_1p-_o6Pz7mX_IBx9vf2lnU671mFFiA0oC6tmRD--5qZxZpBtVxUb1OHb92A5YbUY6pzWx7Szy0EvVMaLVSg3SsVucrbz5wJREraTGVtcOUTXDKPueFC56EY1k58uR6rJx4YvyGt7Hi1Ntj70KZivlkYX-I3ASOJ3nWd8vip9R4BT5zAKn703gZH2yT1_gWKFsDLRz8pYyrD6yg8iUwhvaVt6B1sIJVooZfHyRY3hmuCWKDh7JX1AS2bvAqUrGPU4fgs9dLxp528mHr1n5NdXL4P8AAAD__1xNbQM)race facility nearly $550,000 after fans invaded the track during the cooldown lap of Sunday’s U.S. Grand Prix in Austin. Although fans are allowed on the track for podium celebrations after the race, about 200 spectators [climbed over fences to reach the track](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7GOhCAUAL8GOs3jgSIFxTV2e-2V5gm4kqAYIev695e9_vrJTObnMT0oprg_v2kLtr6XPCGgagQ0KCdPMd2T4t7O4I3gwQqNptemG5CvVgoJxgEtMIgFnRlcD3J25ADmDnvBo_3IBKAUILGTrUcUajCgNQmc5cwUBB9rPtu6hhreVJZ051c4W5c3nuxa61GY_GI4Mhyv62q3u9BOe817zB-I4ViOfNbCcKSzRpcCw9HlSs0S9-AbYYZOgdHtsR78tP64Ykqx9JopeG4U01-q_vv-svgbAAD__8HbWrc) before all drivers had stopped. | | Dear Fellow American,

Is it possible to repair the CIA?

**[To answer this question, Hillsdale College has created a FREE online video series on the history and current crisis in U.S. intelligence](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c4fa806180b24791beb5fd81f9f1e44b&_e=9fAW8xDgOG353784FfbvEheZtOJmlLVTm9z16z52ivbSUDvz1c13Fxgna1U4Kxz8bdq2OGBbmZGIEMkMjWbV5xFKIBVY2dvdqvvrrx5xljp3RThybGZd_vvohhf2sIBl3aIBfbD93U6ZQMkHEGgySDzRiaRiCJkje3IdGI59DJwLN4vkym94dN5bYYgERkrWDw4MdeJ0G1aftmcs1nEEa3mwA4sd4Zc0UHsvyrC5ulWFmIQp8lhzBmLCGLGuQMvXR5OT1bDrT2CJD0M7MrCYJH6A2J18Unb4aOMAW4fNA4JRjDlXbY71iHlTpwWGqTWvn4JW1voGoJKmppoB978_6Vwq0of-AnfJkGa_CLQQxGuALuKpwePH8KQSMHkoHD4I_DZQxfIF2vWFZePMvmSQXw%3D%3D).**

In this online video series, filmed during a conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn why we need intelligence and how it is used against American citizens and duly elected leaders.

The CIA--originally founded as the OSS--was created in the aftermath of Pearl Harbor to help protect America from foreign threats. But in the last few decades, this notorious agency...
* FAILED to foresee the 9/11 attack and then took over a decade to find Osama Bin Ladin

* COVERED for the Obama administration after the assault on our embassy in Benghazi that led to four American deaths

* THREATENED the sovereignty of the American people with the Russia collusion hoax

* FAILED to warn Americans about COVID-19

* HID the origins of the Hunter Biden laptop and declared it Russian disinformation

America's Founders would not recognize this notorious intelligence agency.

We still need intelligence to help protect us from foreign threats. We needed it in the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, and we need it even more today.

But now, the CIA serves its own interests...not those of the American people.

And so, it's no surprise that anyone in power who goes after the CIA is soon _not_ in power.

You might remember when New York Senator Chuck Schumer told MSNBC, **" Let me tell you, you take on the intelligence community, they have six ways from Sunday at getting back at you."**

Whether or not Schumer meant to make such a revealing statement, it is further evidence that you and I live in a country in which powerful government agencies do not operate according to the consent of the governed.

How did we get to this point? And how can we reform the CIA and our other intelligence agencies?

**I invite you to learn more about this critical topic through our free video series, U.S. Intelligence: History and Controversies.**

Good morning, friend! It's a great day for democracy! Ohioans are voting early in person right now and **Election Day is just 13 days away** , so I've had my coffee, and I'm fired up and ready to go!
Republicans have outspent us 3-to-1 to launch nasty attack ads, so we're fighting back by doing what we've always done – talking directly to voters. body:
Grand Junction ‘Rumble’ rallies support for conservative movement in Colorado
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, October 23, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Grand Junction ‘Rumble’ rallies support for conservative movement in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The Rocky Mountain Rumble held Sunday in Clifton gathered Western Slope conservatives under a shared mission: fighting for rural Colorado’s future and energizing the community ahead of crucial elections._
_Hosted by Rocky Mountain Voice’s founder Heidi Ganahl, the event underscored the importance of unity, local leadership and economic opportunity as the region grapples with state and federal overreach._
_Mesa County resident and attendee Vicky Murphy says she’s been a political junkie for years, often speaking her mind and she’s noticed a change in locals around her lately._
_“People that I’ve known for years who never opened their mouth about politics are suddenly very chatty,” she said. “They have passion [and] concern, and they want an outlet for it.”_
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[SB 24-008 has expedited the process of placing about 4,500 Colorado children in foster care](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Montrose County commissioners, led by Sue Hanson, approved $1.5 million to support foster care organizations like Kin-Connect, focusing on helping children removed from unsafe homes and their caregivers.
* Kinship care, where children are placed with relatives, is being prioritized, with recent legislation (SB 24-008) providing funding and expediting the process for caregivers.
* A grandmother’s story highlights the emotional and financial challenges kinship families face when taking in children with little to no resources.
* Organizations like Kin-Connect offer crucial support to these families and are calling for financial donations, especially to help children during the holiday season.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Young Republicans to host forum on crime and law reform](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Federation of Young Republicans is hosting a public safety forum on October 23rd at the American Legion in Denver, focusing on crime deterrence and legislative reform.
* Chairman Jack Gilmartin will emphasize the need for stronger crime deterrents and challenge legislators, including Governor Polis, to enact policies that prioritize public safety and address human behavior.
* John Fabbricatore, former ICE Field Office Director, will discuss the importance of coordination between local and federal law enforcement in effective crime prevention.
* George Mumma, former Police Chief and candidate for HD-25, will speak on the need for criminal justice reform based on his 40 years of law enforcement experience.
* The forum will also feature perspectives from several State Senate and House candidates, addressing policies to improve safety and reduce crime in Colorado.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Opponents to Prop. 127 rally at state capitol, asking voters to deny proposed ban](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A rally at the Colorado State Capitol opposed Proposition 127, which seeks to ban "trophy hunting" of mountain lions, bobcats, and lynx, citing concerns about its impact on rural Colorado and wildlife management.
* Opponents argue that wildlife management should be handled by experts, not voters, as current hunting regulations by Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) help maintain ecological balance.
* They warn that the ban could harm rural economies, increase taxpayer costs, and disrupt effective conservation efforts.
* Financial backing for the proposition comes from out-of-state groups, raising concerns about external influence on Colorado’s wildlife policies.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[When casting your vote, are ballot ‘selfies’ illegal in Colorado? Should you do it?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX 31 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Ballot selfies are illegal in at least 14 states due to concerns over voter coercion, bribery, and intimidation, though some free speech groups argue they should be allowed.
* In Colorado, ballot selfies are legal under state law, joining other states like California, Oregon, and New Mexico in permitting voters to share photos of their completed ballots.
* Concerns about preserving ballot secrecy, such as potential voter intimidation, have been cited by states that prohibit ballot selfies. Proponents of legal ballot selfies argue that modern concerns over vote-selling or coercion are outdated and that sharing ballot photos is an expression of civic participation.
* There is no federal law governing ballot selfies, leaving regulations to individual states, with punishments for violations varying significantly by state.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Terrifying map reveals how bloodthirsty Venezuelan gang Tren de Aragua has infiltrated America](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DAILY MAIL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Tren de Aragua, a violent Venezuelan gang, has spread its criminal activities across the U.S., with a significant presence in cities like San Antonio, Texas, and El Paso, Texas.
* The gang has taken control of several apartment complexes in Aurora, Colorado, and has been involved in serious crimes, including shootings, drug trafficking, and forced prostitution.
* Tren de Aragua operates similarly to a mafia, with its members sending money back to leaders in Venezuela, and is more organized than other gangs like MS-13, rapidly expanding in a short time.
* Law enforcement in the U.S., including Homeland Security Investigations and local police, are actively arresting gang members, but the gang continues to pose a serious threat with its criminal network.
* The gang's presence in U.S. cities has led to increased violence and human trafficking, with law enforcement agencies setting up task forces to combat the organization’s influence.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Sloan: Reflections on Brett Baier’s Fox News interview with VP Kamala Harris](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KELLY SLOAN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The inestimable Peggy Noonan, in her regular Sunday Wall Street Journal column, was exacting, as usual, in her analysis of Kamala Harris: “This week she couldn’t answer a single question straight, and people should see it. She is an artless dodger.”_
_A bit little later on in the piece, referring to a typical word-salad response, Harris proffered to a question: “That isn’t the answer of a candidate trying to be forthcoming and using her limited time in an attempt to be better understood. It is the sound of someone running out the clock.” And further on yet: “What are her thoughts, right now, about illegal immigration and the border?... Was the influx a good thing? Why? Does it constitute a national emergency? Why? What attitude does she bring to this crucial question? Failing to speak plainly and deeply now about illegal immigration is political malpractice on a grand scale. There are other large questions. What philosophical predilection does she bring to taxing, spending, regulation, to the national debt? She owes us these answers. It is wrong that she can’t or won’t address them. It is disrespectful to the electorate.”_
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Davidson: Asking questions about election integrity doesn’t make someone an ‘election denier’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JOHN DANIEL DAVIDSON, [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_A sensational report in The Wall Street Journal implies that questioning the integrity of our elections is tantamount to domestic terrorism._
_If Americans have questions and concerns about how our elections are administered and how ballots are tabulated, does that make them “election deniers,” conspiracy theorists, threats to democracy?_
_The Wall Street Journal seems to think so. In a long news report published over the weekend headlined, “‘It Feels Very Dystopian.’ Republican County Officials Brace for Election Deniers—Again,” the Journal repeatedly characterized those who think the 2020 election was stolen, rigged, or less-than-secure as “election deniers,” and stopped just short of calling them domestic terrorists._

clean_body: Grand Junction ‘Rumble’ rallies support for conservative movement in Colorado | | | | PRESENTED BY | | Hi friends, This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, October 23, 2024. – Heidi Ganahl | TODAY'S TOP STORIES The Rocky Mountain Rumble held Sunday in Clifton gathered Western Slope conservatives under a shared mission: fighting for rural Colorado’s future and energizing the community ahead of crucial elections. Hosted by Rocky Mountain Voice’s founder Heidi Ganahl, the event underscored the importance of unity, local leadership and economic opportunity as the region grapples with state and federal overreach. Mesa County resident and attendee Vicky Murphy says she’s been a political junkie for years, often speaking her mind and she’s noticed a change in locals around her lately. “People that I’ve known for years who never opened their mouth about politics are suddenly very chatty,” she said. “They have passion [and] concern, and they want an outlet for it.” | Montrose County commissioners, led by Sue Hanson, approved $1.5 million to support foster care organizations like Kin-Connect, focusing on helping children removed from unsafe homes and their caregivers. Kinship care, where children are placed with relatives, is being prioritized, with recent legislation (SB 24-008) providing funding and expediting the process for caregivers. A grandmother’s story highlights the emotional and financial challenges kinship families face when taking in children with little to no resources. Organizations like Kin-Connect offer crucial support to these families and are calling for financial donations, especially to help children during the holiday season. | The Colorado Federation of Young Republicans is hosting a public safety forum on October 23rd at the American Legion in Denver, focusing on crime deterrence and legislative reform. Chairman Jack Gilmartin will emphasize the need for stronger crime deterrents and challenge legislators, including Governor Polis, to enact policies that prioritize public safety and address human behavior. John Fabbricatore, former ICE Field Office Director, will discuss the importance of coordination between local and federal law enforcement in effective crime prevention. George Mumma, former Police Chief and candidate for HD-25, will speak on the need for criminal justice reform based on his 40 years of law enforcement experience. The forum will also feature perspectives from several State Senate and House candidates, addressing policies to improve safety and reduce crime in Colorado. | A rally at the Colorado State Capitol opposed Proposition 127, which seeks to ban "trophy hunting" of mountain lions, bobcats, and lynx, citing concerns about its impact on rural Colorado and wildlife management. Opponents argue that wildlife management should be handled by experts, not voters, as current hunting regulations by Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) help maintain ecological balance. They warn that the ban could harm rural economies, increase taxpayer costs, and disrupt effective conservation efforts. Financial backing for the proposition comes from out-of-state groups, raising concerns about external influence on Colorado’s wildlife policies. | Ballot selfies are illegal in at least 14 states due to concerns over voter coercion, bribery, and intimidation, though some free speech groups argue they should be allowed. In Colorado, ballot selfies are legal under state law, joining other states like California, Oregon, and New Mexico in permitting voters to share photos of their completed ballots. Concerns about preserving ballot secrecy, such as potential voter intimidation, have been cited by states that prohibit ballot selfies. Proponents of legal ballot selfies argue that modern concerns over vote-selling or coercion are outdated and that sharing ballot photos is an expression of civic participation. There is no federal law governing ballot selfies, leaving regulations to individual states, with punishments for violations varying significantly by state. | Tren de Aragua, a violent Venezuelan gang, has spread its criminal activities across the U.S., with a significant presence in cities like San Antonio, Texas, and El Paso, Texas. The gang has taken control of several apartment complexes in Aurora, Colorado, and has been involved in serious crimes, including shootings, drug trafficking, and forced prostitution. Tren de Aragua operates similarly to a mafia, with its members sending money back to leaders in Venezuela, and is more organized than other gangs like MS-13, rapidly expanding in a short time. Law enforcement in the U.S., including Homeland Security Investigations and local police, are actively arresting gang members, but the gang continues to pose a serious threat with its criminal network. The gang's presence in U.S. cities has led to increased violence and human trafficking, with law enforcement agencies setting up task forces to combat the organization’s influence. | BY KELLY SLOAN, The inestimable Peggy Noonan, in her regular Sunday Wall Street Journal column, was exacting, as usual, in her analysis of Kamala Harris: “This week she couldn’t answer a single question straight, and people should see it. She is an artless dodger.” A bit little later on in the piece, referring to a typical word-salad response, Harris proffered to a question: “That isn’t the answer of a candidate trying to be forthcoming and using her limited time in an attempt to be better understood. It is the sound of someone running out the clock.” And further on yet: “What are her thoughts, right now, about illegal immigration and the border?... Was the influx a good thing? Why? Does it constitute a national emergency? Why? What attitude does she bring to this crucial question? Failing to speak plainly and deeply now about illegal immigration is political malpractice on a grand scale. There are other large questions. It is disrespectful to the electorate.” | BY JOHN DANIEL DAVIDSON, A sensational report in The Wall Street Journal implies that questioning the integrity of our elections is tantamount to domestic terrorism. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: tightening
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
You deserve more than just a relentless stream of fundraising emails without a hint of substance
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2111%2E135344%2EEk3EJd)

You deserve more than just a relentless stream of fundraising emails without a hint of substance, so I wanted to take a moment to send a message with a deeper look at the state of play here in Michigan with the hopes that treating you as more than just an ATM machine inspires you to donate to my campaign today. Okay, here goes:
When you start with the presidential race, one thing you can see over the past month is that things are tightening.
I am a bit of a numbers person, and from time to time I'll look at polling averages from people like Nate Silver (who’s actually a Michigander, by the way). And in his analysis you can see that the change over the past month, and the past week has been in Trump's favor.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241023-1-900&t=2&akid=2111%2E135344%2EEk3EJd)
You can see that tightening is represented visually here as well.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241023-1-900&t=3&akid=2111%2E135344%2EEk3EJd)
This is important for a number of reasons, not the least of which is something that you instinctively know -- which is whoever wins Michigan is likely to win the presidential election.
What about our race?
Public polling shows it's getting closer as well. If you look at the latest polls, two of the last three show our race a tie, with three polls this month showing that same result.
You can also see that in the Real Clear Politics polling averages. It's just gotten tighter over the past few weeks.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241023-1-900&t=4&akid=2111%2E135344%2EEk3EJd)
So what does that mean for your support?
First, you know that we like to talk about our success with "losing better." That means doing better in the "red" parts of my district and the state than Democrats normally do.
One of the ways we do that is by turning out Democrats who don't always vote. That's good for me, of course – but it is also good for Kamala Harris.
But that work takes resources, and it means we are fundraising up right through the time the last ballot is cast.
So if you are looking for a place where your donation goes further than almost anywhere else right now, I hope this message has convinced you why my race is a good place to win.
[**Please make a contribution to my campaign today. Our average online donation is around $40. Many give less. Some give more. All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing today to help us reach our final budget goals.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241023-1-900&t=5&akid=2111%2E135344%2EEk3EJd)

### Question 4 Press Conference by Coalition for Safe Communities
---
---
| The Coalition for Safe Communities cordially invites you to a press conference tomorrow, October 24th, at 12:00 PM at the Robert Gould Shaw Memorial in Boston Common.
Ballot Question 4 would legalize for-profit centers, home-growing, and the statewide distribution of psychedelic drugs, which could lead to a dangerous black market. With drugged driving already on the rise and many users admitting to driving under the influence, this measure would increase the risk of accidents.
The psychedelic drug ibogaine is linked to serious health risks, including heart issues, while edibles pose a danger to children and pets. Proposed distribution centers wouldn't be required to be run by medical professionals, exposing vulnerable individuals to potential harm.
Passing this question would not only compromise public safety but also burden taxpayers with the cost of creating another commission, similar to the troubled Cannabis Control Commission. For these reasons, we urge voters to reject Question 4.
R.S.V.P at [info@safecommunitiesMA.com](mailto:info@safecommunitiesMA.com)
