### Question 4 Press Conference by Coalition for Safe Communities
---
---
| The Coalition for Safe Communities cordially invites you to a press conference tomorrow, October 24th, at 11:00 AM at the Robert Gould Shaw Memorial in Boston Common.
Ballot Question 4 would legalize for-profit centers, home-growing, and the statewide distribution of psychedelic drugs, which could lead to a dangerous black market. With drugged driving already on the rise and many users admitting to driving under the influence, this measure would increase the risk of accidents.
The psychedelic drug ibogaine is linked to serious health risks, including heart issues, while edibles pose a danger to children and pets. Proposed distribution centers wouldn't be required to be run by medical professionals, exposing vulnerable individuals to potential harm.
Passing this question would not only compromise public safety but also burden taxpayers with the cost of creating another commission, similar to the troubled Cannabis Control Commission. For these reasons, we urge voters to reject Question 4.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=4237%2E35263%2EJLEmoN ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

Peter — I know my
team and I have been reaching out a lot about my reelection race, but
today, I hope you’ll let me share a story about my very first campaign.

When I first ran for Congress in Wisconsin, no one thought I could win —
especially when an extremely popular challenger entered the race.

I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time. She said, “Well,
Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s going to
be tough.”

I looked her right in the eye and asked, “Do you think I should wait my
turn?”

Then I said this: I believe that women have to run and not wait our turn —
especially when it’s hard. We can’t wait until we get a tap on our
shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere.

Defying the odds, I ended up winning that race, and became the very first
woman elected to the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And that was
just the first time our team would make history.

When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots
supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us
off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the Senate from our
state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history.

And then in 2018, despite being a top target for national Republicans and
enduring over a year of attacks, you stood with me again, and together, we
won.

I’m used to being written off,
Peter. But time and again,
grassroots supporters like you have helped us defy the odds. And we’ll
need to do it once more, because the fight to protect my seat is tougher
than ever before.

Eric Hovde and his Republican allies have already spent more than $79
million to buy this seat, and they’re currently outspending us statewide.

Recent polls show Eric Hovde in the lead, multiple elections experts have
downgraded our race rating in Hovde’s favor, and now, Mitch McConnell’s
super PAC launched $24 million on attack ads against me — which he
wouldn’t do unless he knew Hovde could win and flip Wisconsin red.

Protecting this seat while Republicans are outspending us on the airwaves
won’t be easy, but together, I know we can defy the odds once again.

Can I explain something, Peter?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
**
And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.
[That’s why I’m personally asking you to join my reelection team and split $10 between Lucas Kunce and my campaign today to help us defend Montana’s Senate seat. — Jon

USO Supporter,
National Day of the Deployed is coming up this weekend, and we hope you'll take a moment to remember the hundreds of thousands of service members and military families currently facing the unique hardships of deployment.
**Ahead of this important day, we 're inviting caring military supporters, like you, to learn more about how your donations support service members deployed all over the world: [Will you take a moment to learn more now? ](https://links.e.uso.)**
[SEE YOUR SUPPORT IN ACTION](https://links.e.uso.)
---
We want to share exactly how big of an impact you make for our heroes by strengthening their connections to home, providing essential supplies, supporting our USO Centers and ensuring our staff can be there for them when they face the biggest challenges of their military service.
That's because our work to be there for people who serve, as well as their families, through long and difficult deployments simply wouldn't be possible without supporters like YOU.
So please: **[Take a virtual journey with us now to see the impact of your support for service members deployed around the world.](https://links.e.uso.)**
[SEE YOUR SUPPORT IN ACTION](https://links.e.uso.)
---
Thank you.
--Team USO

name: Neil Parrott
subject: Vote Early on Thursday if you want us to win!
body:
Voting early is the best way you can support my campaign right now! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=e9bdb7d656)
---
|
---
| | Peter,

Early voting starts Thursday, October 24th and runs through Thursday, October 31st. We are encouraging EVERYONE to vote early this year if you can. Don't leave Election Day to chance. Don't let traffic, bad weather, illness, or a family emergency keep you from the polls. Every vote counts, and that means YOURS. This race will be so close, and we can't afford to let anyone stay on the sidelines or miss an opportunity to cast a ballot.

You can vote early from 7 am to 8 pm, and you can do so at any Early Voting center in the county where you live. You can also register to vote the same day that you cast your ballot.

All the details on Early Voting are at [_**THIS LINK.**_](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=e06949318b&e=5a45ee1154)

**Our latest polling shows that we are leading my Democratic opponent, April McClain-Delaney, by 4 points!** This is HUGE but we still have lots of work to do.

My opponent is spending the day before Early Voting out of state, in New York City, fundraising with Hillary Clinton. I will be talking to voters throughout district 6, knocking on doors, making phone callsm and putting up signs with my team of volunteers. Quite the difference, isn't it?

We have the momentum, and we need to keep it up. **The easiest way you can help us FLIP THIS SEAT is by VOTING EARLY starting Thursday morning.**
---

| I'm also cordially inviting you to our victory party on November 5th. It'll be at the same place we celebrated after the Primary Elections. [Havana](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=52ae4f6025&e=5a45ee1154) in Hagerstown, 913 Dual Highway. It is right off of Rt. 70, and easy to find. Please join us there starting at 9 pm!

**The entire Leadership team in the U.S. House of Representatives just endorsed me. Jim Jordan, Elise Stefanik, Tom Emmer, Steve Scalise, and Speaker Mike Johnson have all personally given me their endorsement and encouragement. **They know we're so close.

**We'll need YOU to help put us over the top though. If you want to volunteer, please email contact@neilparrott.org right away**. If you can spare ANYTHING to help us flip this seat, we need your help competing against my opponent's wealth and out-of-state, left-wing donors like Hillary Clinton. **[Please donate.](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=a06706da3d&e=5a45ee1154)**

And once again, please get to the polls and [**VOTE EARLY, starting THURSDAY**.](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=a0bfc30557&e=5a45ee1154)

Neil Parrott

| | | | |
# ▶️ Protecting Social Security: A Promise We Must Keep

Peter- did you know Social Security, a lifeline for so many, is currently under threat?
[**Please watch the video below to understand the urgent need to protect Social Security and the challenges facing those who depend on it:**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=ce591041d5&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=631695cdb8&e=a2a46ff12c)
| For many, Social Security is a critical support system that ensures dignity and security in our later years. Yet, it is in danger from those who seek to undermine its integrity.
Created during the Great Depression, it was designed to shield our elders from poverty and hardship and has since embodied our values of kindness and solidarity.
Today, some dismiss it as just another entitlement, neglecting the promise we’ve made to ourselves and future generations.
This isn’t just about policy—**it’s about upholding our shared commitment to those who rely on this essential program.**
We contribute to Social Security throughout our careers, trusting it will be there for us when we need it most.

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 23
KELLY LOEFFLER DEMANDS MORE TRANSPARENCY, CALLS FOR ANSWERS ABOUT NON-CITIZEN VOTERS IN GEORGIA
(ATLANTA) - Today, following the publication of results from Georgia's non-citizen voter roll audit, Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler called on Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger to answer key questions after he initially refused to release the results and misrepresented its findings for more than three months. She demanded greater transparency from Raffensperger and called on him to address the questions raised by the audit's findings.
Raffensperger [released](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKXaw1rdv3bshxMtn8VBl5yThuck0OSGq-mMtd4VGSGwZ5vnn3p_jUMlUk9Sk5oWCF6G1T1v5TCLXlSCXADJfEL7-WMa2L2z4ogDmw3hEoNusyOGyFrMC0ZI-27y773F3W53As2OJ3v_nhYU68IU-aAku4GjRXj9lHyABIJv3zwAlChsoSGLWKZiCpYhiM_na0lLmsPT7ssIHC2e7JrK3LakhM80xJrOqzOZZ7rsduwcS&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==) the results of his audit late last night, weeks after Greater Georgia called on him to do so. According to his [memo](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKXaw1rdv3bsh6b2O1i8oRn3hc_LlqOxTpesSvp_jUhuOB77vOJ2aM_bZ1LHuvZ_u0M26wSgVTGTV4y1-RHt_rccEpLTGhpBsybNtAo5Hn6Ry_nMJF9lXTEd_7N7X--Ig8GGNelASG3EDB-N4n3fX26gh51GSdKDf6XPQ7vLpfoiJ1FJzYRrSZzs=&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==), Raffensperger uncovered 20 non-citizens and 156 potential non-citizens on Georgia's voter rolls. Nine of the non-citizens successfully voted in previous Georgia elections.
The abrupt admission, which comes in the middle of Georgia's early voting period, is a direct result of Greater Georgia's advocacy. Last month, Loeffler wrote a [private letter](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKXaw1rdv3bshnBmADhxFlm_LKJkdh93rvZnsU8kaZyz-O9Lv8K92Rtv2O_XUfaGz17t1zfEqez0iCpEFii3u3-RwTKqQ3uR15PlDcMEFU9GiO2uiJhUbKReZPSYNoQHTakfjzDNR_T4UlhrLzB6uTB-8KP7_F1lovjfLZ7ow1OfvYHdkeFKCAALf0z5XItTZibUzanapYn8ge9-1DSYse1cbBj2VaX7_Jqg8g1p3cviRFULUHnBeUVBOrONDHWc3ifCSRpv_Ujd4zKwLgSOPJSURMXEMKNmUos_2r2nFCQ9rBv7d52lzaPtYeThB4sZn5x9LN3REDDon-S5EuEvk_7ozYP1fUVxhHxbedHMDvq2mftuic1-n5tEXzNqxLMbGAK5VsXp03g7Ka2MTN0li3d2RZg47of1J-GOpVFR47YI6q-4F5Z_lBeovbR9uR-BY3NvXlIm18iqWCQKpRuaDy04=&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==) to Raffensperger urging him to release the results of his audit but never received a response. It was only on Monday, after Greater Georgia[ ](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKXaw1rdv3bshBZvJ5EuRZGZ3U1UimpmNV67dBLsYiM5sRy1Fn7RwT8nGPXa_rLpl00T1NqYUq32c7ekBJhK5JMDzQZeiRZg4oOuwHuw6KMZQKnS2nIPYkfAOmHbkmmcnWJatnTICOp4vx6ezuBSOyEX2MInLpFS7Iu4oOL1hWB0CFBWuX1CPzvazmGRZar9ryssAtrBn_qiKrCH_8pVbByS2ippORJsWGg==&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==)[publicly](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKXaw1rdv3bshBZvJ5EuRZGZ3U1UimpmNV67dBLsYiM5sRy1Fn7RwT8nGPXa_rLpl00T1NqYUq32c7ekBJhK5JMDzQZeiRZg4oOuwHuw6KMZQKnS2nIPYkfAOmHbkmmcnWJatnTICOp4vx6ezuBSOyEX2MInLpFS7Iu4oOL1hWB0CFBWuX1CPzvazmGRZar9ryssAtrBn_qiKrCH_8pVbByS2ippORJsWGg==&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==) called on Raffensperger to release the results of the audit, that his office suddenly announced its intention to share them. The office said that a[ ](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKdAI88ycad5IxJlLoiJJiZ4Be2KA90lZoyzRBBswujClVurHjnIkang8bAIoOj9yQC0fYNx_ed3JSqG91VhLerVqp1WPL6puVrLFS-EDVdJIKlHjFPh-z16LVsJ8DAwQGNxDn7zet1Fj3Qf6QTfZS12yIMJoFEjYo1RFBZZnX05aACEQahhlIA8=&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==)[previously scheduled](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKdAI88ycad5IxJlLoiJJiZ4Be2KA90lZoyzRBBswujClVurHjnIkang8bAIoOj9yQC0fYNx_ed3JSqG91VhLerVqp1WPL6puVrLFS-EDVdJIKlHjFPh-z16LVsJ8DAwQGNxDn7zet1Fj3Qf6QTfZS12yIMJoFEjYo1RFBZZnX05aACEQahhlIA8=&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==) press conference would be[ ](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKdAI88ycad5InVuzs5BVroRf7yABv7wGjNBWtH7nPlCGwDnvDPxz9WvPTn-v6z-sQlZxdX8MVzNxM_gYi12AuJN33zXZNI92ulmXMo1ZQp7Elc0UtKs1bmo-ErGXswy_PSI20K84kH52Hrnnh23xaaRRiRUXGoD_u7dZhpCRo8BpXexiJY3aAeU=&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==)[amended](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKdAI88ycad5InVuzs5BVroRf7yABv7wGjNBWtH7nPlCGwDnvDPxz9WvPTn-v6z-sQlZxdX8MVzNxM_gYi12AuJN33zXZNI92ulmXMo1ZQp7Elc0UtKs1bmo-ErGXswy_PSI20K84kH52Hrnnh23xaaRRiRUXGoD_u7dZhpCRo8BpXexiJY3aAeU=&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==) to include the findings of the audit.
Raffensperger previously claimed that the audit was completed in July, at which time he announced that it uncovered "zero" non-citizens on the voter rolls.
As he [said](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKXaw1rdv3bshM_4qf2Ezv-KYsRIqbyRnZwNL3se2iYar0tr5ksMUVOk4NxjVF6kDHAYja6LgCVEx_Uj7kC5aCdwzNY_QC_kDtI0NdFTkG8JK-4xFdaLGmHZk4qMAfK_7et9b5M86o_4u&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==) three months ago: "I did a 100% audit. We found no non-citizens on the voter rolls, which means that only American citizens are voting. I just did the second audit, finished it up last week, and we got the same results. So I can tell my fellow Georgians: only American citizens are voting." Since then, Raffensperger has made similar guarantees about the audit's findings while simultaneously refusing to release them to the public.
Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler issued the following statement:
"The revelation that 20 non-citizens - and potentially 156 more - have registered to vote in Georgia is long-awaited information that Georgians deserve to know. But it is deeply concerning that our Secretary of State refused to share his findings for months - and during that time, repeatedly and falsely assured voters that 'zero' non-citizens were registered to vote. Voters just want the truth - and if state officials continue to withhold or misrepresent it, they will soon erode the trust that has been rebuilt in our system thanks to strong laws and advocacy.
"Although the window to demonstrate a commitment to transparency is rapidly closing, I encourage Secretary Raffensperger to embrace it for the remainder of the 2024 election cycle. He should begin by answering the following questions about the non-citizens on our voter rolls."
Raffensperger's [memo](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKXaw1rdv3bshQnzuouMPdpzVApHoG9QQ7gF6RvZPMFh74FFDkg-ExE04SxedA_dIrziGHRAtavtWWyD9VJDdycpfYBia8YQVDMQJQFN5RJa9b6jfBIyk0C--G6bevZd8lqF2fA2iIW3QCs3gKTKuOwWee7RDRavtVnQi6caX-oISHOLKTRyshk5gGzjI1nVOoDyWFRRp-qe3-uQTjRGLLcKlPm9WY3el_KCoQTvmjPpMoycGlwHk2Vp8QP7Eo4xA6ff5CINoXUqDGjJboJ-4egCrArwnL__AcAUTGYT51KHjoX_L9dwYxlool1Lo7VzVU13eDPmx-NuAtziyzrZjaCssB381wq-_X6aixsYZF3DH6WZlVGH5x5JiguRHKHn4mkEHBZeo35S_OLUbHmeHk6OhS_Lzd8z-2HRXY6UZlLCZpIbsotEw74pjz7KDIBN-koY5NURF2MZl-Uhc7-lTrfI=&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==) detailing the results of the citizenship audit leaves a number of questions that must be answered, including:

* Why did it take three months to release the results?
* Why did Raffensperger previously claim that the audit was completed in July?
* How did non-citizens subvert Georgia's voter registration process to become eligible voters, and how will processes be changed to prevent it in the future?
* When will the review of the 156 potential non-citizens be completed?
* What accounts for the sudden spike in non-citizen voters, given that zero non-citizens were found on our voter rolls during the [last audit](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKXaw1rdv3bshUujZS0KjWFrk_7mT1BnwrMYfXUK6i8xEk9_XHAp19XEFNghOJwBQcrczvPB6Pil1OT1hpGJ02iHnNfUFBRpSBPKAGswQJLF_3GRqyKvxcTfeLS7x2aEzZ7yO598iYY_LXYzR5h62Ysytn7LM6F_iuaPTPvV6KPlF2FYmuaDKVDyzAehNstOcsw==&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==) two years ago?
* Were any of the non-citizens among those [identified](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001e_YhFca4rWRpsGHdhBby-NpZFru3JKAOguDFVW6hA1zwKw3MMg-cKXaw1rdv3bshImugJRjl6tKW3eGVzNFsLShTONGEUKKTyVR4bo_nynBEy35CVQ0xZiY3PB1RRvdYeF-PFqM46UIlraxef2ZCMiLdTRdldjgXTl-R04SgBmuPlLMfCSDQkLN8rUlko-ikiX5ioLIDG5A=&c=n5jAU_k_cKsxa0XqSddRn9AMZOYomiwUN52sqjTXv-lu6RF4-tzrsA==&ch=eXpHXu47aJm4FkckJsQ6GjSbVwq8EppdZEnwBFDxdE2CmGlqQx-vrQ==) by the Oversight Project?

According to his ==, Raffensperger uncovered 20 non-citizens and 156 potential non-citizens on Georgia's voter rolls. Nine of the non-citizens successfully voted in previous Georgia elections. The abrupt admission, which comes in the middle of Georgia's early voting period, is a direct result of Greater Georgia's advocacy. Last month, Loeffler wrote a == to Raffensperger urging him to release the results of his audit but never received a response. It was only on Monday, after Greater Georgia== called on Raffensperger to release the results of the audit, that his office suddenly announced its intention to share them. The office said that a== press conference would be== to include the findings of the audit. Raffensperger previously claimed that the audit was completed in July, at which time he announced that it uncovered "zero" non-citizens on the voter rolls. As he == three months ago: "I did a 100% audit. We found no non-citizens on the voter rolls, which means that only American citizens are voting. I just did the second audit, finished it up last week, and we got the same results. So I can tell my fellow Georgians: only American citizens are voting." Since then, Raffensperger has made similar guarantees about the audit's findings while simultaneously refusing to release them to the public. Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler issued the following statement: "The revelation that 20 non-citizens - and potentially 156 more - have registered to vote in Georgia is long-awaited information that Georgians deserve to know. But it is deeply concerning that our Secretary of State refused to share his findings for months - and during that time, repeatedly and falsely assured voters that 'zero' non-citizens were registered to vote. Voters just want the truth - and if state officials continue to withhold or misrepresent it, they will soon erode the trust that has been rebuilt in our system thanks to strong laws and advocacy. "Although the window to demonstrate a commitment to transparency is rapidly closing, I encourage Secretary Raffensperger to embrace it for the remainder of the 2024 election cycle. He should begin by answering the following questions about the non-citizens on our voter rolls." Raffensperger's == detailing the results of the citizenship audit leaves a number of questions that must be answered, including: Why did it take three months to release the results? Why did Raffensperger previously claim that the audit was completed in July? How did non-citizens subvert Georgia's voter registration process to become eligible voters, and how will processes be changed to prevent it in the future? When will the review of the 156 potential non-citizens be completed? What accounts for the sudden spike in non-citizen voters, given that zero non-citizens were found on our voter rolls during the == two years ago? So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4e7020c9617949c5ab2981398efab490&_e=yPPyERAUT3lc1lC_NJ0m8_QHhWsGsKmWPThXypaT9nUvFqQ0sqau5LlUSmJl9ywKtDOliNFJ1_jPzb9L772ZWrm1hazE6-c_mfczU6iEVWrseaenTdPRZc96GY0ArDypZ6Q1ZJVzTzBS9rDQG7KwjXMJQr93cRIQj71lZeLjP517IgvPIp1h2GBqo4HFLFWEJuAG9oWqbNaHRgxa0eQPo1-8Mxd-v_cxEEzXoIS-to4A8lz0BxMdwDnF76d9lSb0KyLrdbUV2UAg_lNHgSo7xH_lQZ_UhMKYBJlmc2B2QuJGMTpuhyDwclpabFVRzfbewYmfEo1LwFiXBixrtB8-F-vvAriWuTBGpGZqH1v2t22oP8tfoqD0c-YoAdWOSHz1jdRrt4sPTPH9JxRuhCk-DYlRTuH2YgxX2ex9NGrgd2I%3D)

Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4e7020c9617949c5ab2981398efab490&_e=yPPyERAUT3lc1lC_NJ0m8_QHhWsGsKmWPThXypaT9nUvFqQ0sqau5LlUSmJl9ywKtDOliNFJ1_jPzb9L772ZWrm1hazE6-c_mfczU6iEVWp3BKrG90r8ZRMmSShK3YGyl-Q4Mq_54iyitEmW0ZZMgkgTEs3hfkdpL5JmgE2eM0tlyZjA11GJSR1mRw0lNqvVjnL1fVjo2luWVrChswHJL9eFDEDtjjg-15qkxfkjvXsMsFbl2JaAHLN9-LBmFJhVjhEz8HH8JxMtkJQ59CH63jprG9PCcNIHelxxwvlEz3icQ3rDNLy61OVMS_3IGJt8Whr-ekUzc5M1Rzc7KhO7jvUeyuR_XC6MybQ4DO3FIP7dzTxdYpUNYBKYtykhz9hYl_6IWg8f4mKCULoHNqnnz2MjWiNNJOs0Yd0AfeALR7Q%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4e7020c9617949c5ab2981398efab490&_e=yPPyERAUT3lc1lC_NJ0m8_QHhWsGsKmWPThXypaT9nUvFqQ0sqau5LlUSmJl9ywKtDOliNFJ1_jPzb9L772ZWrm1hazE6-c_mfczU6iEVWrseaenTdPRZc96GY0ArDypZ6Q1ZJVzTzBS9rDQG7KwjXMJQr93cRIQj71lZeLjP517IgvPIp1h2GBqo4HFLFWEJuAG9oWqbNaHRgxa0eQPo1-8Mxd-v_cxEEzXoIS-to4A8lz0BxMdwDnF76d9lSb0KyLrdbUV2UAg_lNHgSo7xPQzGw6-wSIeWiJcrmLr7_YyW2kp_uqukhNHi3WpDggJUN4Fm6sVmTlbyO1lbPWM2bnHQ91jODYbJhUaEGA6igdGAbpKFvPqwDPLkdIew_TBa0h4R_BVbiHWDGoQN3JYE_ir2mhf6MD65vCUuTcOKu4%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4e7020c9617949c5ab2981398efab490&_e=yPPyERAUT3lc1lC_NJ0m8_QHhWsGsKmWPThXypaT9nUvFqQ0sqau5LlUSmJl9ywKpA89EBH8oZnEg_iG4pzb4U9LMYydC_285NCQ8cPoXTdSPAHCiVY4kWZwND-pEkZ8lx3TxBgMI72iXQtRwKOzEZvy4ravesc0SBLlTLsx49AoYT4dqje4H4dtQ_lS9WT_r1co9Dmmn6H8ewSwCkxyyfgmEAecTzArPgLnC1O4WfT7XzjObumYv0tAWpoIPLnWVtcCo8pT66X4oInUxzCjUudPI-ZHhMkKGe0WBObrQGJrt3KW5MvWiPhv_6Euc6qcMwZz9ssoSUggfjsHZ1w0CXgvgjlpDiXsC9ccB_yvSbCE8JHzuXrPm4Kjt-VWpauPT88tk4-bR_nnH43v44vgPTIfEaGbzLek7PqGKNUSQxY%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4e7020c9617949c5ab2981398efab490&_e=yPPyERAUT3lc1lC_NJ0m8_QHhWsGsKmWPThXypaT9nUvFqQ0sqau5LlUSmJl9ywKtDOliNFJ1_jPzb9L772ZWrm1hazE6-c_mfczU6iEVWrseaenTdPRZc96GY0ArDypZ6Q1ZJVzTzBS9rDQG7KwjXMJQr93cRIQj71lZeLjP517IgvPIp1h2GBqo4HFLFWEJuAG9oWqbNaHRgxa0eQPo1-8Mxd-v_cxEEzXoIS-to4A8lz0BxMdwDnF76d9lSb0KyLrdbUV2UAg_lNHgSo7xPkrhMZ1werPZ4FkBFAbXSV8gIJkfDxDyzQaVoRfadEI1TjqO5bAM1XVFdZ9EPxNRuJFdODCy8fZdWt0ELyvwo6NsicqXHiHoQ_CriGcs-l_LcF2WnJGPvHYtznrD0pbMUDyO5yTRPpGLTuTanUfzrM%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4e7020c9617949c5ab2981398efab490&_e=yPPyERAUT3lc1lC_NJ0m8_QHhWsGsKmWPThXypaT9nUvFqQ0sqau5LlUSmJl9ywKtDOliNFJ1_jPzb9L772ZWrm1hazE6-c_mfczU6iEVWrseaenTdPRZc96GY0ArDypZ6Q1ZJVzTzBS9rDQG7KwjXMJQr93cRIQj71lZeLjP517IgvPIp1h2GBqo4HFLFWEJuAG9oWqbNaHRgxa0eQPo1-8Mxd-v_cxEEzXoIS-to4A8lz0BxMdwDnF76d9lSb0KyLrdbUV2UAg_lNHgSo7xFf842ppQo1Ac40Yb0ibvA2hgnVWTRy_HDLsQRGZWyfpSgChIdVLtum-KoqQ9GOTfnx5-k14dCzj_0TGi3-DY3V2Qvpr-RUc9plyPB3svog7KKwOzCmwx5ZEzpAtyOsVCGHrjSQ7CQKc2xqCCPwg39M%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=4e7020c9617949c5ab2981398efab490&_e=yPPyERAUT3lc1lC_NJ0m8_QHhWsGsKmWPThXypaT9nUvFqQ0sqau5LlUSmJl9ywKtDOliNFJ1_jPzb9L772ZWrm1hazE6-c_mfczU6iEVWrseaenTdPRZc96GY0ArDypZ6Q1ZJVzTzBS9rDQG7KwjXMJQr93cRIQj71lZeLjP517IgvPIp1h2GBqo4HFLFWEJuAG9oWqbNaHRgxa0eQPo1-8Mxd-v_cxEEzXoIS-to4A8lz0BxMdwDnF76d9lSb0KyLrdbUV2UAg_lNHgSo7xKm0nmbDb2v7P_rm0DUcQpUrcsFR-L6aN5e1jc-lNZJFGjEKVxcvF7-nKhe2xoSVzef5Lw0j7w4wbC1j123qR6UZiC8TsIjmyFAx4adMOxwTLzKpyUTSDArikT955TJWgTYgkPuDSapsISOPaOvIXRM%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

clean_body: So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. | Fellow Conservative, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. body:
https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com [https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com]
Dear Tennessean,
We are in the final stretch— early voting ends on October 31st ! Now is the time to turn out in force and show up for the future of Tennessee.
Every vote counts —this is not just another election. Our values, our families, and our communities are on the line. Kamala Harris and the entire Democratic ticket need your support to win this critical race.
In West Tennessee, Jesse Huseth is in a prime position to flip a Republican-held seat. Jesse is fighting for affordable healthcare, quality education, and economic justice. But this race is tight—we need every single vote to secure this victory.
In Middle Tennessee, Luis Mata is counting on us to get to the polls. He’s working to uplift our communities and push forward policies that matter to every Tennessean. With your vote, we can bring his vision to life.
The time is now! Don't wait until it's too late. Vote by October 31st , and make sure your voice is heard. Share this message with your friends and family, and encourage them to vote as well. We need everyone to show up if we want to win.
Together, we can change Tennessee for the better. Let’s make history—starting today!
All the best,
Lee Harris
Mayor of Shelby County
P.S. Every vote matters. Share this message with as many people as you can. Let’s make this count before it’s too late.

#

Fast forward a few weeks, Peter.
Imagine we’ve defeated Donald Trump and Kari Lake in Arizona. What happens next?
Well... we have some idea. We know what they did last time.

Victory in the first place is not guaranteed. Recent polling in Arizona has our race narrowing over the last few weeks, and Donald Trump is either tied or ahead.
But even if we do win... the path isn’t certain. Kari Lake and Donald Trump have refused to say that they would accept the results of this election, and they have made their willingness to push our democracy to the brink absolutely clear.
So, right now, we’re fundraising to win. We’re working around the clock to reach the voters we need to defeat Kari Lake and Donald Trump in Arizona.
But we’re also fundraising because there is no telling what we need to prepare for the day after Election Day. Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.

Derek — less than two weeks remain in the most important election of our lifetimes.
We need you to know the latest about Donald Trump’s relentless attacks against Adam.
**FIRST** , with less than 25 days in this election, Donald Trump hosted a MAGA rally in Coachella, California. In case you missed the articles in the Daily Mail and even TMZ, I just sued Trump-hating TV host Bill Maher.

[**I need your help to hold him accountable.**](https://5gcvd67r.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flibersend.loomered.com%2Fl%2FbZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA%2Fowv5Nw40iVjndhTSIBILdQ%2F763763qujWCxTbecm0Nm4o1hCg/3/01000192b9afab9a-c73dd6f3-5558-41df-91ba-bb3cca966195-000000/TFTMhl6htOmbYlf9wfHavBswtUw=397)

On his HBO show, Maher falsely accused me of having an affair with President Trump.

| | Fellow American, There is a powerful movement in our culture to teach young Americans that our nation’s history is **oppressive** and **shameful**. Sometimes, this effort goes under the name “critical race theory.” Other times, activists advance these ideas through works like _The_ _New York Times_ ’ __ “1619 Project.”

This radical movement pushes a narrative that slavery, not freedom, is the defining characteristic of American history. They teach our children that we should replace equal individual rights with the idea of unequal rights based on group identity.
---

| | | Rudy Giuliani spread dangerous lies and conspiracy theories about Georgia election workers Ruby Freeman and her daughter, Shaye Moss, in the aftermath of the 2020 election. He made their lives hell – and now he's paying the price. Giuliani owes the election workers $150 million in damages (awarded from a civil case), so a federal judge ordered Giuliani to hand over his Manhattan penthouse apartment as well as his luxury car, expensive watches, sports memorabilia, furniture, jewelry, and more. Rudy Giuliani is finally getting what's coming to him after sending the MAGA mob after these two women who were simply counting ballots on Election Day. [**Join us in thanking the judge for delivering justice and making Rudy Giuliani pay for his disgusting behavior >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0e58d1a9-686a-457d-bbc6-749300524330/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=80438ba0cd5347b685ea78d5f591ffce&_e=IX8X3bJw81PnnyKYZ_RmN6l3hU4SP4R_DIA6NMY5vxt72yum7Ghf9GriGmA2ezgpucI-WHPzaoQghHOIwG1RWOtCQXZDGyCeFlzPx6F0KfKMDIYIdPqJ6b0Z75zcyBEnQxkUbYIEQ6WZADSfU7QQjANachaxaw523rUy4jGYYLn_eY9EeOHRxpADD2LG8AXV5e2QCuh30gY4m8z05yeigApOCuhq2FLylntpANYnUw_w94pkJDHOy0CNmkuz5OoKon42D0SuFh8HKAB7TsVW-jUo4YbXn6hiKaNcDiefZaab9QbnUfPWAK_pwcsmwyuzUza8VkEqwUGvZKoi3_bKnn3msreKXUedJrhC8BF1Cva9ifIGPmok-jDT6mfMVOTz6QTR0IVNrCXrk_3UfA_5G42CFrZw34ahgDJB6f2OXXI%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=80438ba0cd5347b685ea78d5f591ffce&_e=IX8X3bJw81PnnyKYZ_RmN6l3hU4SP4R_DIA6NMY5vxt72yum7Ghf9GriGmA2ezgpucI-WHPzaoQghHOIwG1RWOtCQXZDGyCeFlzPx6F0KfKMDIYIdPqJ6b0Z75zcyBEnQxkUbYIEQ6WZADSfU7QQjANachaxaw523rUy4jGYYLn_eY9EeOHRxpADD2LG8AXV5e2QCuh30gY4m8z05yeigApOCuhq2FLylntpANYnUw_w94pkJDHOy0CNmkuz5OoKon42D0SuFh8HKAB7TsVW-k71LbD2NQB4yrZz7pfpmG55Gl1fm-agBCtkx_ZL6FXj9TwIPSxsT4Ke3n-zElRtW3n_C0NJZymMxmnhOHwD3KH9veIBNiNbm4Wg3dOR_c0cp-FY17tJuV0unAn4utaWFQULi_wXSXQ_VEhPy4U2QTs%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

[**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=80438ba0cd5347b685ea78d5f591ffce&_e=IX8X3bJw81PnnyKYZ_RmN6l3hU4SP4R_DIA6NMY5vxt72yum7Ghf9GriGmA2ezgpucI-WHPzaoQghHOIwG1RWOtCQXZDGyCeFlzPx6F0KfKMDIYIdPqJ6b0Z75zcyBEnQxkUbYIEQ6WZADSfU7QQjANachaxaw523rUy4jGYYLn_eY9EeOHRxpADD2LG8AXV5e2QCuh30gY4m8z05yeigApOCuhq2FLylntpANYnUw_w94pkJDHOy0CNmkuz5OoKon42D0SuFh8HKAB7TsVW-kHZy0KzAZNX2iYHxsRTuROQ3ewSS7DhdqaDVi7RV_FGwlhGo5MTLM0_2hYPkzcY5u1oC5Nprkfp7IEfuKjIPHLDOVfVO9xg4oyyUUK_oG9RM5AxwBaA9CC9mW8Ivp0fdqNYCLLSKsb1Y5x967vxDXY%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=80438ba0cd5347b685ea78d5f591ffce&_e=IX8X3bJw81PnnyKYZ_RmN6l3hU4SP4R_DIA6NMY5vxt72yum7Ghf9GriGmA2ezgpucI-WHPzaoQghHOIwG1RWOtCQXZDGyCeFlzPx6F0KfKMDIYIdPqJ6b0Z75zcyBEnQxkUbYIEQ6WZADSfU7QQjANachaxaw523rUy4jGYYLn_eY9EeOHRxpADD2LG8AXV5e2QCuh30gY4m8z05yeigApOCuhq2FLylntpANYnUw_w94pkJDHOy0CNmkuz5OoKon42D0SuFh8HKAB7TsVW-iGABoENJ38h0TtNBrMxf5q8dd43ZZPJ8RbQjKRu3KFD6zvk7m2YmVMl0mckB8u11vSlMjlyApQ2OihoepHcGZckksqbW-wgwH9YE34rKzkNSMiLyAQ00qk3onwgUQFH0VU7qI1Xnjs6h5HsbUqREEI%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=80438ba0cd5347b685ea78d5f591ffce&_e=IX8X3bJw81PnnyKYZ_RmN6l3hU4SP4R_DIA6NMY5vxt72yum7Ghf9GriGmA2ezgpucI-WHPzaoQghHOIwG1RWOtCQXZDGyCeFlzPx6F0KfKMDIYIdPqJ6b0Z75zcyBEnQxkUbYIEQ6WZADSfU7QQjANachaxaw523rUy4jGYYLn_eY9EeOHRxpADD2LG8AXV5e2QCuh30gY4m8z05yeigApOCuhq2FLylntpANYnUw_w94pkJDHOy0CNmkuz5OoKon42D0SuFh8HKAB7TsVW-lzsOWXOfxu0rbr7rEEtaLZyvWp25vcTf8shDnLC7skmEG9yniV6Ng6QPGFjeQwJHauqzA0_L7bquQA2cmtlVka6CH11KchTCMimCjtw7_el_epNyEpLBj45Tna7pgqpLLoDl602m1_ZbOdiVyR5ufk%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. For America's Future, Tim Sheehy Former Navy SEAL Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL." | PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Derek, I know things are busy. If you don’t have time to read this whole email, I’ll ask right now: Will you chip in any amount to support Tim’s re-election campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024] He’s working around the clock to turn out Democratic voters in every corner of Virginia, and he needs our support.
If you do have a few minutes, I’d like to talk to you about my friend Tim Kaine. If you mention Tim to anyone who knows him — whether it's a member of his church congregation who sang with him in the choir or a Republican senator who works with him across the aisle — you're likely to hear the same thing: Tim is a relentless optimist.
It’s that optimism, learned from his mom Kathy, that drives his belief that no problem is unsolvable , so long as you’re willing to put in the work.
His commitment to solving problems and delivering results has been clear throughout his career, from his time as a civil rights lawyer in Richmond to his tenure as Governor of Virginia and his two terms serving in the U.S. Senate.
Derek, I could give you a laundry list of things he’s accomplished during that career — from fighting housing discrimination to lowering prescription drug costs to helping cut child poverty in half — but what I believe is most important to know about Tim is that he's sincerely motivated by the belief that you can make a difference in people's lives through public service.
When I ran for president eight years ago, that was a huge part of why I chose him as my running mate. And when we lost that election, it gave me great hope and comfort to know that Tim would remain on the front lines of our democracy, representing Virginia in the Senate.
This November, Tim is up for re-election, and his opponent — like many Republicans running for office around the country — is a self-described MAGA follower who has been endorsed by Donald Trump.
You and I both know how important this election is — leaving Trumpism unchecked in any corner of our country is not an option.
We also both know that grassroots donors have the power to drive Democratic victories, so I’m asking you today: Will you pitch in $20, or whatever amount is meaningful to you, to elect Tim Kaine and defeat Trumpism in Virginia this November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Losing the 2016 election was hard — for all of us. It's also hard to continue fighting, day after day and year after year, for the America we still believe in. But what would be hardest of all is giving up — especially when the stakes are so high.
One thing I can say for certain about Tim Kaine is that he will never stop fighting for you. Guided by his love of this country and his care for the people he serves, he will continue to do all the good he can, for all the people he can, in all the ways he can, as long as ever he can.
Meanwhile, Tim’s opponent is more focused on tearing people down and parroting Donald Trump’s divisive rhetoric than actually getting things done:
He has peddled conspiracy theories about the 2020 election and even pledged to release and seek compensation for January 6th insurrectionists. He wants to repeal the Affordable Care Act and put Social Security on the chopping block. He has even compared abortion to the Holocaust, and has supported legislation that would drastically limit access to reproductive care.
Believe me — I know a dangerous Republican extremist when I see one. We can’t afford to let Tim Kaine’s opponent anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
Will you help make sure Tim can defeat his extreme opponent and keep doing good for Virginia families in the Senate? Your contribution to his re-election campaign will go directly towards critical voter outreach in this final stretch. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $20 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=20]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=100]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
When it’s all over, none of us want to look back with regret, wishing that we could have done more — so whether it’s donating today, making sure your friends and family have a plan to vote, or volunteering in your community, I encourage you to join me in taking action before November 5th.
Thank you,
Hillary

1490-5A Quarterpath Road #272
Williamsburg, VA 23185
Emails like this one are a critical part of staying in touch during this important election year. We value your support, and are so glad to have you on the team. Dear Peter,

In 2013, singer-songwriter Vanessa Carlton suffered an ectopic pregnancy and had to be rushed into emergency surgery to save her life. She reflects, [**"If that had happened to me today in the wrong state, I may not have survived. Women in the same situation are now being turned away from hospitals because of abortion bans."**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95637516/507391901/-1110707151?sourceid=1149974&utm_campaign=25emcge-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=1000miles&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNjYWQ4MC00ZTkxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sB55DVRaRdkPXE895cwBCLDCO2EJ2pzhc8I57Nl3MLc=&emci=ea70ffe6-b790-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=313cad80-4e91-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237)

Vanessa has teamed up with the Center and re-recorded her Grammy-nominated hit song "A Thousand Miles", sharing her personal story to raise awareness about the urgent need to fight for reproductive freedom. | [**🎥 WATCH NOW**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95637517/507391902/-1110707151?sourceid=1149974&utm_campaign=25emcge-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=1000miles&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNjYWQ4MC00ZTkxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sB55DVRaRdkPXE895cwBCLDCO2EJ2pzhc8I57Nl3MLc=&emci=ea70ffe6-b790-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=313cad80-4e91-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237 "WATCH NOW")

[**Last year, 171,000 people were forced to travel hundreds—sometimes thousands—of miles for essential abortion care due to restrictive state laws. Many thousands more weren't able to make that journey.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95637519/507391904/-1110707151?sourceid=1149974&utm_campaign=25emcge-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=1000miles&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNjYWQ4MC00ZTkxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sB55DVRaRdkPXE895cwBCLDCO2EJ2pzhc8I57Nl3MLc=&emci=ea70ffe6-b790-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=313cad80-4e91-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237)

We invite you to join us in this critical campaign—watch the video, [**share it with your community,**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95637520/507391905/-1110707151?sourceid=1149974&utm_campaign=25emcge-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=1000miles&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNjYWQ4MC00ZTkxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sB55DVRaRdkPXE895cwBCLDCO2EJ2pzhc8I57Nl3MLc=&emci=ea70ffe6-b790-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=313cad80-4e91-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237) and stand with us as we demand that no one should be forced to travel for health care they should be able to receive at home.

[**Together, with your support, we can keep fighting for a future where everyone’s reproductive freedom is protected.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95637522/507391907/-1110707151?sourceid=1149974&utm_campaign=25emcge-1003aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=1000miles&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNjYWQ4MC00ZTkxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sB55DVRaRdkPXE895cwBCLDCO2EJ2pzhc8I57Nl3MLc=&emci=ea70ffe6-b790-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=313cad80-4e91-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237)

Thank you for being with us on this journey.

Warmly,

### MassGOP Urges a No Vote on Question 2: Defending High Educational Standards for Massachusetts
---
---
| Boston, MA- The Massachusetts Republican Party is firmly urging voters to reject Question 2 on the November ballot, which seeks to eliminate the MCAS graduation requirement. Doing so would undermine the very progress and high standards that have positioned Massachusetts' education system as one of the best in the country.
The 2024 MCAS results reveal declines, particularly in English Language Arts, with younger students experiencing the most significant drops in performance. Despite these troubling trends, the Massachusetts Teachers' Union is advocating for the removal of MCAS as a graduation requirement, dismissing it as merely a "snapshot" of school performance. This dismissive stance overlooks the fact that MCAS has long been a critical tool in setting clear expectations for students and educators alike, ensuring that schools uphold the rigorous standards for which our state is known for.
"Question 2 is a step in the wrong direction," said Amy Carnevale, MassGOP Chairwoman. "Rather than lowering our expectations, we should be working to restore and raise the standards that have made Massachusetts a leader in education. Removing the MCAS requirement diminishes the incentive for schools to meet high standards, which will only further harm student achievement."
In addition to the threat it poses to academic excellence, Question 2 could exacerbate the state's ongoing migrant crisis. By lowering education standards, it opens the door to the issuance of high school diplomas to migrant children, even if they have not mastered fundamental skills in English, math, or science. The implications of this are far-reaching, both for the quality of education and the integration of migrant children into American society.
"Massachusetts already has a right-to-shelter law, and if Question 2 passes, we'll essentially create a right-to-a-diploma law," Carnevale added. "Without the MCAS requirement, migrants won't be held to the same high standards that have made our schools great. This does a disservice to everyone involved--migrant children included--by setting them up for failure in the long run."
The MassGOP stands firm in its belief that every child in Massachusetts deserves a high-quality education that prepares them for success. Weakening standards by removing the MCAS graduation requirement will only hinder that mission. For these reasons, the MassGOP strongly encourages a No vote on Question 2.

Americans should reject GOP framing that "Democrats oppose Voter ID." Why? Because, one, they don't, and two, the MAGA fixation on _new_ Voter ID requirements is nothing more than a brazen attempt to suppress the vote, thus winning elections by marginalizing Black, brown, and low income people. MAGA Voter ID laws have nothing to do with election security, and everything to do with dismantling our democracy, and the receipts back up this fact. **Let 's Address This.**
**Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. I invite you to invest as a subscriber.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..M7wUGRDGQBodR-PWv2H__XWv4aU9lpWb2ITFiEG7gSE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=150412291)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/89df5483-1577-494b-adde-919f07c0b264?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Credit: ACLU of North Carolina
Republicans claim we need the Voter ID laws they're pushing to "secure elections." This is a lie for a number of reasons.
### Vote ID Already Exists
Voters **already** present an ID when registering to vote. Always have. Zero Democrat bills or policies have ever tried to change this. Zero scenarios exist in the United States where someone is able to register to vote without their government issued ID card. And this fraud protection works extremely well. [Since 2000 there've been only 31 credible allegations of voter impersonation in over 1 BILLION votes cast](https://substack.com/redirect/e16a12ce-d8b0-4177-9e95-16b51d52a70b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Let me repeat that: 31 out of 1 BILLION. And zero times have these 31 measly votes ever flipped an election--ever.
The Republican Voter ID laws are a solution in search of a problem that doesn't exist. It's no surprise that as President, Donald Trump disbanded his own voter fraud commission, twice, due to a lack of any actual evidence of fraud.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ad7b7464-953d-4415-828c-c3fda800f77a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### New GOP Voter ID Laws Are Built Off of Jim Crow
Second, the GOP Voter ID bills are built off of Jim Crow racism and designed to target and suppress Black voters. These bills have nothing to do with securing our elections. For example, the US Appeals Court struck down North Carolina's discriminatory Voter ID law, [ruling](https://substack.com/redirect/641d2ab9-63c1-4178-a45a-a6878a6bb4ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The law was intentionally designed to discriminate against black people. North Carolina legislators had requested data on voting patterns by race and, with that data in hand, drafted a law that would target African-Americans with almost surgical precision.
The Court realized that North Carolina's Republican legislators studied voting habits of voters in North Carolina, and learned that Black voters in particular:
* tend to register and vote the same day
* use a particular form of ID to register to vote
* disproportionately vote early rather than on Election Day
* get their kids registered in high school to vote when they turn 18, and
* often vote out of precinct at wherever is most convenient based on where they work

After studying these habits, North Carolina Republicans passed Voter ID requirements that banned same day registration, banned out of precinct voting, ended high school registration, eliminated early voting, and created a new Voter ID requirement that mandated an ID that Black people were least likely to have.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7ed20edd-ee05-4d9d-b2ec-8f843223da52?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
North Carolina Republicans did all this not because of voter fraud or election fraud--but because they were losing elections as more and more Black people voted. In fact, North Carolina Republicans did not provide a shred of evidence (because none exists) that the aforementioned positive voting behaviors of Black voters resulted in any sort of fraud. Thus, rather than change their political platform to attract more voters, Republican politicians changed the rules of how to vote to restrict more voters who oppose them, and enable more voters who support them. This isn't democracy, this is dictatorship.
And this is precisely what Republicans in Georgia, Florida, Texas, and the over 360 bills introduced nationwide are doing to restrict voting access. This is wrong, undemocratic, and modern day Jim Crow. In short, GOP's Voter ID mythology is to distract from their Jim Crow reality.
### GOP Voter ID Laws Are Deliberately Burdensome
Finally, reject the MAGA claim that says "it's easy to simply get a new ID card." That misses the point that a new card shouldn't be required in the first place, when a confirmed Voter ID card already exists. And likewise, it cruelly ignores that obtaining a new ID card takes time and money. And for American citizens, particularly if they're living paycheck to paycheck, or have childcare responsibilities, or a strict job schedule, or are part of the sandwich generation and also taking care of their parents--adding additional arbitrary burdens (or five more arbitrary burdens like in the case of North Carolina) succeeds only in one thing--restricting turnout.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c17c33c8-37a3-43aa-9bea-ccb1074518ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Credit: Brennan Center for Justice
And in purple states like North Carolina where elections are won or lost by less than a few points, restricting just enough voters from the _other_ party's base can flip an election. And _that_ is the real election fraud we should be working to stop.
### Conclusion
Here's the bottom line. If your first reaction to losing an election is to prevent American citizens from voting next time, then you don't believe in democracy--you believe in dictatorship. The Republican attempts to delegitimize our elections through misinformation, disinformation, and Jim Crow voter suppression is dangerous to our democratic process, devastating to the security of our republic, and evil-minded through and through. It's long past time we reject these racist MAGA Voter ID laws, once and for all. That's how we protect our elections, and our Republic.

Ohio Capital Journal: Ohio Sec. of State LaRose proposes eliminating ballot drop boxes, changes rules ahead of election [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=102324_1&amount=25]
Drop boxes are threatened in Ohio by the very elected official whose job is to run the election, Team.
Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose has asked leaders in the Ohio state legislature to create a law eliminating ballot drop boxes even after a court ruled that people with disabilities should have more opportunities to vote.
LaRose also used his own powers as Secretary of State to add more steps before voters can use drop boxes ahead of the November election. His actions will disenfranchise millions of voters this fall : 1 in 4 Ohioans voted absentee in their last election, according to state data.
This hurts Ohio's voters, from working families to college students to the elderly. An Ohio state senator summed it up for everyone: “ They make it tougher for people to vote, make it tougher for people to take their own spouse’s ballot to the one box in the county that they’re allowed to have to drop off their ballots, anything they can do to make it tougher to vote. ”

Peter.

Chuck Schumer and the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee are now jumping into this race to rescue endangered career politician Martin Heinrich.

**They’re funneling out-of-state dollars into New Mexico to buy up precious advertising time during the final weeks and days before Election Day.**

They know they were completely caught off guard when I entered this race and have been watching nervously as we’ve gradually caught up to Heinrich in the polls.

Now, they can’t stand to sit by any longer and are frantically trying to stop our upward momentum.

With New Mexico being one of the smallest states and cheapest media markets in the 2024 fight for the Senate, the money they’ve raised from West and East Coast liberal elites stretches much further here, _which means they can do A LOT more damage with much less._

But that also means your support goes much further here, [**and I’m asking you to help rebalance the scales and prevent Schumer and his deep-pocketed allies from buying this election at the last minute.**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=0fe5345e7a5a49f4be9abced1b27c805&_e=OPNwTTAYT1RDtRviPJfxXb_QxCVwCnMaOot_FknZV6-47MZHYz8UXR-vqJSH2IqVlCHYuUq_tIIYQyfnHYI9V7tzpz2zRyjR2Hkd8jsxOVurA8gBnOA5Bn56j0TuN9NzGsB-VoPXboRpZN_W3d_8tGCWc3bdY6tgUt9eX4BZ1gQ69rAb4oDQdZmRKYVuz82EBkNWUWMsqvAKIaMo1TjBZypeO9eEGRuwLGsUoJrnoVI8ADNQ6tuIB34D-SlxOxlNRVqP1SfgZNVubOWZDOmR75zAJP6k4MxDptisKe-NDB74Y-J4g6YUkW9E_TWEXsLboMFJ0GCZJfmY4-OHy2TkTrE23U0cMPlyIIx6Th0uhnTxzzgxaJQlNi1y4xgfgpmbtPcsjSP9N_AewJzmXHwrSg%3D%3D)

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

### Have you ever experienced FOMO?
The “Fear of Missing Out”
---
It’s hard to believe you could miss anything in this election, given the 24/7 news coverage. **Yet, there is a real chance of missing out** **during this year’s election**.

If you don’t carefully analyze a candidate’s positions on the issues, you miss the opportunity to vote for the person best aligned with your values.

If you don’t vote, you miss the opportunity to help create the future you desire for your friends and family.

If you don’t talk to your friends about voting, you miss the opportunity to multiply your impact and influence in this election.

**At the end of the day, this election is about voting** , not news coverage, polls, or commentary from “the experts.” ** You don’t want to miss it.
**

clean_body: | | Have you ever experienced FOMO? The “Fear of Missing Out” It’s hard to believe you could miss anything in this election, given the 24/7 news coverage. Yet, there is a real chance of missing out during this year’s election. If you don’t carefully analyze a candidate’s positions on the issues, you miss the opportunity to vote for the person best aligned with your values. If you don’t vote, you miss the opportunity to help create the future you desire for your friends and family. If you don’t talk to your friends about voting, you miss the opportunity to multiply your impact and influence in this election. At the end of the day, this election is about voting , not news coverage, polls, or commentary from “the experts.” You don’t want to miss it. We CAN and MUST mobilize people to vote against them. **UWDA made the strategic and difficult decision to endorse Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz because we know we must do everything we can to defeat Trump. ---
Friends -
I’ve been voting for over 40 years, and my first vote was for Ronald Reagan. And in 2022, I did something I had never done before: campaigned on behalf of a Democrat, for Elissa Slotkin in her congressional campaign.
I endorsed Elissa in her race in 2022 because I had seen her work in the House, and I know that she is someone who is laser-focused on doing the right thing for the people she represents and will put service to our country over service to herself, every time.
The choice to me was clear then, and it’s even clearer now. **That’s why I am supporting Elissa Slotkin in her campaign for United States Senate in Michigan.**
The stakes in this election are unlike anything we've ever faced before. But the future of our democracy is on the line, and this is not about policy differences. It’s about doing what’s right for our country.
Donald Trump, if he is reelected with a Republican Congress, will be far more dangerous than we have ever seen before.
And if Elissa loses in Michigan, he will likely get that chance.
We have a responsibility to future generations to ensure that our republic survives. This is not just about the next four or six years—it’s about the kind of country we want to leave for our children and grandchildren.
[**If you’re ready to join me in this fight to preserve our democracy for future generations, please consider contributing $25 or more to Elissa Slotkin's campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241023-2-900&t=3&akid=2110%2E135344%2E6e-Jg5)

subject: 👻 I scream, you scream, we all scream for tax fairness! 👻

body:
https://freedomva.org/ [https://freedomva.org/]
Friends-
This Halloween, hardworking Virginia families are preparing costumes, putting up decorations, and getting excited for the spooky holiday. But many of these Virginians are being spooked by more than goblins, ghouls, and ghosts.
Any Virginian who makes more than $17,000 a year [https://www.wvtf.org/news/2023-12-20/is-it-time-for-a-millionaire-tax-in-virginia] pays the same percentage in taxes as millionaires. This means that teachers- who receive 10% less in salary than the national average [https://www.fundourschoolsva.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Teacher-and-Staff-Pay-Fact-Sheet-Dec-2021-external.pdf#:~:text=Virginia%20teachers%20are%20paid%2C%20on%20average%2C%20just%2067,for%20Virginia%27s%20typically%20high%20wages%20for%20other%20professions.] - and millionaires are in the same tax bracket.
The ultra-wealthy should be paying their fair share to fund schools, affordable housing and quality child care. It’s time for tax fairness in Virginia.
Shinji Oh

Hello,
After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make.
When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits.
Ultimately, though, after the recount, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country.
We were outspent heavily by Boebert and her allies. And the attacks and the vicious lies they told about me were really hard on my family – especially my two teenage children.
After we came so close to winning against Boebert, everyone expected me to run again in 2024. It seemed like a no-brainer. But it wasn’t an easy decision to put my family through what I knew was going to be an even nastier race than the last.
I spent a lot of time reaching out to supporters and donors like you, listening and getting their advice. And everyone promised me: They’d have my back. So I took a leap of faith.
Now, with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this seat is going to be much harder to win. The Super PACs are attacking me and the smear campaign is beginning. I need your help if I’m going to have the resources it takes to finish the job and win this critical House seat.
I made the decision to run again because I knew I could count on people like you to help me win, so it would mean so much to me if you could chip in to my campaign today:

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Trump’s back tomorrow. I need you with me.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Trump’s been talking a lot about our fellow Americans as the “enemy from within” lately, and about using the Military to crack down on them when he’s president. He’s said they’re “radical left lunatics.”
#

Peter, Trump’s back in Arizona tomorrow.
And if I had to guess, he’ll be back again after that.
Trump’s been talking a lot about our fellow Americans as the “enemy from within” lately, and about using the Military to crack down on them when he’s president. He’s said they’re “radical left lunatics.”
Well, he called me a “lunatic” the other day, and he called me a “maniac” before that, so I guess when he’s talking about the “enemy from within” he means me. He’s attacked me every time he’s come to Arizona over the past few months, and I’m sure he will again tomorrow.
Donnie, I’m shaking in my boots.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241023-2-160&t=1&akid=3430%2E734936%2ESA7Kaz)
I don’t scare easy, but there’s one thing about all this that I’ve noticed. Trump knows he’s got to attack me and tear me down to have any shot at winning. I’m pulling voters away from him right and left and that makes his path to victory all the more difficult.
He’s going to keep coming back here, keep trying to turn voters he is depending on against me, because he’s got to defeat me to get back into the White House.
But if we defeat Trump here, that’s it. He’s done. So, look. I need your help to put Trump on his heels. We’ve got to beat this guy.
[**Make a donation to my campaign and help me win in Arizona. If I pull enough folks away from Trump we not only defeat Kari Lake, but we can stop Trump, too. Win-win. Please.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241023-2-160&t=2&akid=3430%2E734936%2ESA7Kaz)
